// 创建宠物状态弹窗窗口
function createPetStatusWindow(message) {
  console.log('Creating pet status window with message:', message);

  // 关闭已存在的小旅星窗口
  if (petStatusWindow && !petStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing pet status window');
    try {
      petStatusWindow.close();
      petStatusWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing pet status window:', error);
      petStatusWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newPetStatusWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 220,
    height: 120,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true,
    hasShadow: false
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.loadFile('petStatus.html');

  // 智能计算弹窗位置，避免被桌面边框遮挡
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 获取宠物窗口位置和大小
  let petPosition, petSize;

  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 强制刷新位置信息
      petPosition = petWindow.getPosition();
      petSize = petWindow.getSize();

      // 验证位置信息的有效性
      if (petPosition && Array.isArray(petPosition) && petPosition.length === 2 &&
        petSize && Array.isArray(petSize) && petSize.length === 2) {
        console.log('Pet window position:', petPosition, 'size:', petSize);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Invalid position or size data');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting pet window position:', error);
      petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
      petSize = [100, 100];
    }
  } else {
    petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
    petSize = [100, 100];
    console.log('Using default pet position:', petPosition);
  }

  // 气泡窗口的尺寸
  const bubbleWidth = 220;
  const bubbleHeight = 120;
  const bubbleTailHeight = 16; // 尾巴的高度

  // 计算最佳位置
  let bubbleX, bubbleY, bubbleDirection;

  // 计算桌宠中心位置
  const petCenterX = petPosition[0] + (petSize[0] / 2);
  const petCenterY = petPosition[1] + (petSize[1] / 2);

  // 优先尝试上方位置
  if (petPosition[1] >= bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 上方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  } else if (petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight <= screenHeight) {
    // 下方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'bottom';
  } else if (petPosition[0] >= bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 左侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] - bubbleWidth - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'left';
  } else if (petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight <= screenWidth) {
    // 右侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'right';
  } else {
    // 如果所有方向都没有足够空间，强制显示在上方
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2)));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight);
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  // 确保气泡不会超出屏幕边界
  bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, bubbleX));
  bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, bubbleY));

  // 验证计算出的位置是否合理
  const distanceFromPet = Math.sqrt(
    Math.pow(bubbleX + bubbleWidth / 2 - petCenterX, 2) +
    Math.pow(bubbleY + bubbleHeight / 2 - petCenterY, 2)
  );

  // 如果气泡距离桌宠太远（超过200像素），使用默认位置
  if (distanceFromPet > 200) {
    console.warn(`Bubble too far from pet (${distanceFromPet}px), using default position`);
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - bubbleWidth / 2));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, petCenterY - bubbleHeight / 2));
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  console.log(`Positioning bubble at (${bubbleX}, ${bubbleY}) with direction: ${bubbleDirection}`);
  console.log(`Pet center: (${petCenterX}, ${petCenterY}), Pet position: (${petPosition[0]}, ${petPosition[1]}), Pet size: (${petSize[0]}, ${petSize[1]})`);
  console.log(`Screen size: (${screenWidth}, ${screenHeight}), Bubble size: (${bubbleWidth}, ${bubbleHeight})`);
  console.log(`Distance from pet: ${distanceFromPet}px`);

  newPetStatusWindow.setPosition(Math.round(bubbleX), Math.round(bubbleY));

  // 通过IPC传递消息和气泡方向
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    try {
      console.log('Sending message and direction to status window:', message, bubbleDirection);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('update-status-message', message);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('set-bubble-direction', bubbleDirection);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending message to status window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听窗口错误
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Status window crashed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Status window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件
  newPetStatusWindow.on('closed', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window closed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口失去焦点事件（点击外部关闭）
  newPetStatusWindow.on('blur', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window lost focus, closing');
    if (newPetStatusWindow && !newPetStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      newPetStatusWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 保存到全局变量
  petStatusWindow = newPetStatusWindow;

  return newPetStatusWindow;
}

// 创建右键菜单窗口
function createContextMenuWindow(x, y, petPosition = [0, 0]) {
  // 关闭已存在的右键菜单
  if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing context menu window');
    try {
      contextMenuWindow.close();
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing context menu:', error);
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newContextMenuWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 180,
    height: 180,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true
  });

  newContextMenuWindow.loadFile('contextMenu.html');

  // 智能定位：避免被桌面边框遮挡，并根据桌宠位置优化显示方向
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 菜单尺寸
  const menuWidth = 180;
  const menuHeight = 180;

  // 计算最佳位置
  let finalX = x;
  let finalY = y;

  // 水平方向调整
  if (x + menuWidth > screenWidth) {
    finalX = screenWidth - menuWidth - 10;
  }
  if (finalX < 10) {
    finalX = 10;
  }

  // 垂直方向调整 - 优先显示在桌宠上方，如果空间不够则显示在下方
  const [petX, petY] = petPosition;
  const spaceAbove = y;
  const spaceBelow = screenHeight - y - menuHeight;

  if (spaceAbove >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 上方空间足够，显示在桌宠上方
    finalY = y - menuHeight - 10;
  } else if (spaceBelow >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 下方空间足够，显示在桌宠下方
    finalY = y + 20;
  } else {
    // 上下空间都不够，调整到屏幕边界内
    if (y + menuHeight > screenHeight) {
      finalY = screenHeight - menuHeight - 10;
    }
    if (finalY < 10) {
      finalY = 10;
    }
  }

  console.log(`Context menu positioning: original(${x}, ${y}), pet(${petX}, ${petY}) -> final(${finalX}, ${finalY})`);
  newContextMenuWindow.setPosition(finalX, finalY);

  // 错误处理
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Context menu window crashed');
  });
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Context menu window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件，清理全局变量
  newContextMenuWindow.on('closed', () => {
    contextMenuWindow = null;
    console.log('Context menu window closed, global variable cleared');
  });

  // 监听窗口即将关闭事件
  newContextMenuWindow.on('close', () => {
    console.log('Context menu window closing...');
  });

  // 自动关闭功能
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      if (newContextMenuWindow && !newContextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        console.log('Auto-closing context menu window');
        newContextMenuWindow.close();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error auto-closing context menu window:', error);
    }
  }, 5000); // 5秒后自动关闭

  // 更新全局变量
  contextMenuWindow = newContextMenuWindow;
  return newContextMenuWindow;
}

// 设置全局点击处理器来关闭右键菜单
function setupGlobalClickHandler() {
  if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    return;
  }

  console.log('Setting up global click handler for context menu');

  // 简化版本：直接使用定时器检查右键菜单状态
  const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      clearInterval(checkInterval);
      console.log('Context menu closed, clearing click handler');
    }
  }, 100);

  // 5秒后自动清理
  setTimeout(() => {
    clearInterval(checkInterval);
  }, 5000);
}

// 创建地图窗口
function createMapWindow(travelData = { origin: '武汉光谷', destination: '北京天安门' }) {
  console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);

  // 检查是否已存在地图窗口
  if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Map window already exists, showing and focusing');
    mapWindow.show();
    mapWindow.focus();
    return mapWindow;
  }

  // 清理旅行数据中的乱码字符
  const cleanTravelData = {
    origin: cleanText(travelData.origin) || '武汉光谷',
    destination: cleanText(travelData.destination) || '北京天安门',
    userLocation: travelData.userLocation || null
  };

  // 保存到全局变量
  globalTravelData = cleanTravelData;

  console.log('Cleaned travel data:', cleanTravelData);

  mapWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: false, // 与主页面保持一致
    transparent: false,
    resizable: true, // 允许调整大小
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    movable: true, // 允许窗口移动
    minimizable: true, // 允许最小化
    maximizable: true, // 允许最大化
    show: false // 初始不显示，等待加载完成后显示
  });

  mapWindow.loadFile('map.html');

  // 设置地图窗口位置到屏幕中央
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  mapWindow.setPosition(
    Math.round((width - 800) / 2),
    Math.round((height - 600) / 2)
  );

  // 通过IPC将高德地图API Key和旅行信息传递给地图窗口
  mapWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    // 传递API Key
    console.log('Passing API Key to map window');
    mapWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      window.AMAP_KEY = '${process.env.AMAP_KEY || ''}';
      console.log('API Key set in map window:', window.AMAP_KEY ? window.AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'Not set');
    `);

    // 发送旅行信息
    console.log('Sending travel info to map window');
    setTimeout(() => {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }, 1000);

    // 显示窗口
    mapWindow.show();
  });

  // 监听地图窗口关闭事件，改为隐藏而不是销毁
  mapWindow.on('close', (event) => {
    if (!app.isQuitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      mapWindow.hide();
      console.log('Map window hidden instead of closed');
    } else {
      // 应用退出时清理全局变量
      globalTravelData = null;
      console.log('App quitting, clearing global travel data');
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口请求旅行信息
  ipcMain.on('request-travel-info', () => {
    console.log('Map window requesting travel info');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口隐藏请求
  ipcMain.on('hide-map-window', () => {
    console.log('Hiding map window');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.hide();
    }
  });

  return mapWindow;
}

// 清理文本中的乱码字符
function cleanText(text) {
  if (!text) return text;

  // 移除常见的乱码字符
  return text.replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5\s\-_]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

// 创建通知气泡窗口
function createBubbleWindow(message) {
  bubbleWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 300,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: false, // 禁用透明度以提高兼容性
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    }
  });

  bubbleWindow.loadFile('bubble.html');

  // 通过IPC将AI生成的消息传递给气泡窗口
  bubbleWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    bubbleWindow.webContents.send('update-bubble-message', message);
  });

  return bubbleWindow;
}

// 截取屏幕截图
async function captureScreenshot() {
  try {
    console.log('📸 Capturing screenshot...');
    const sources = await desktopCapturer.getSources({
      types: ['screen'],
      thumbnailSize: { width: 800, height: 600 }
    });

    if (sources && sources.length > 0) {
      // 获取第一张屏幕截图
      const source = sources[0];
      const thumbnail = source.thumbnail;

      // 将截图转换为base64编码
      const base64Data = thumbnail.toDataURL().replace(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg);base64,/, '');
      console.log('📸 Screenshot captured, size:', base64Data.length, 'characters');

      // 使用AI分析截图内容
      console.log('🤖 Analyzing screenshot with AI...');
      const aiResponse = await analyzeScreenshot(base64Data);
      console.log('✅ AI analysis completed:', aiResponse);
      return aiResponse;
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No screen sources found');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Screenshot capture failed:', error);
  }

  // 如果出错，返回默认响应
  console.log('🔄 Returning fallback response');
  return {
    message: "替你去看北京天安门？",
    shouldTravel: true,
    confidence: 0.5
  };
}

// 注册全局快捷键监听截图
function registerScreenshotListener() {
  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F2');

    // 更改截图快捷键为F2
    const ret = globalShortcut.register('F2', async () => {
      console.log('Screenshot taken!');

      // 捕获并分析截图
      const aiResponse = await captureScreenshot();
      console.log('AI analysis result:', aiResponse);

      // 使用小旅星窗口显示AI回复
      createPetStatusWindow(aiResponse.message);

      // 如果AI判断需要触发旅行，则显示气泡提示
      if (aiResponse.shouldTravel) {
        // 显示AI生成的气泡提示
        setTimeout(() => {
          showScreenshotBubble(aiResponse.message);
        }, 1200);
      }

      // 切换宠物表情并设置状态复原
      if (aiResponse.emotion && petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        try {
          petWindow.webContents.send('change-emotion', aiResponse.emotion);
          console.log('Sent emotion change to pet:', aiResponse.emotion);

          // 设置状态并启动复原计时器
          setPetState(aiResponse.emotion);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to send emotion change:', error);
        }
      }
    });

    if (!ret) {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Screenshot listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F3');

    // 注册测试用快捷键
    const ret2 = globalShortcut.register('F3', async () => {
      console.log('Manual water reminder triggered!');
      createWaterReminderWindow();
    });

    if (!ret2) {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Water reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F4');

    // 注册另一个测试用快捷键
    const ret3 = globalShortcut.register('F4', async () => {
      console.log('Manual fun reminder triggered!');
      // 生成AI趣味提醒
      const funMessage = await generateFunReminder();
      createPetStatusWindow(funMessage);
    });

    if (!ret3) {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Fun reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F6');

    // 注册手动重置状态快捷键
    const ret4 = globalShortcut.register('F6', () => {
      console.log('Manual reset pet state triggered!');
      resetPetState();
    });

    if (!ret4) {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Reset pet state listener registration error:', error);
  }
}

// 显示截图响应气泡（放置在右上角）
function showScreenshotBubble(message) {
  const bubbleWindow = createBubbleWindow(message);

  // 设置气泡窗口位置到屏幕右上角（避免遮挡通知区域）
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  bubbleWindow.setPosition(
    width - 310,
    150 // 距离顶部150像素，避免遮挡Windows通知
  );

  // 10秒后自动关闭
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (bubbleWindow && !bubbleWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      bubbleWindow.close();
    }
  }, 10000);
}

// IPC事件处理：开始旅程
ipcMain.on('start-journey', async (event, data) => {
  console.log('Starting journey to:', data.destination);

  // 提取目的地信息（从AI回复中提取地点名）
  let destination = '北京天安门';
  if (data.destination) {
    // 尝试从"替你去看[地点]？"格式中提取地点
    const match = data.destination.match(/替你去看(.+)[？\?]/);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      destination = match[1];
    } else {
      destination = data.destination;
    }
  }

  try {
    // 获取用户当前位置作为起点
    console.log('Getting user current location...');
    const userLocation = await amapService.getUserLocationDetails();
    console.log('User location info:', userLocation);

    // 创建地图窗口并传递旅行数据
    const travelData = {
      origin: `${userLocation.city}`,
      destination: destination,
      userLocation: userLocation
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get user location, using default location:', error);

    // 如果获取用户位置失败，使用默认位置
    const travelData = {
      origin: '武汉光谷',
      destination: destination
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    console.log('Using default location to create map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  }

  // 可以在这里添加更多旅程启动逻辑
});

        petStateTimer = null;
      }

  }
}

}

// 创建宠物状态弹窗窗口
function createPetStatusWindow(message) {
  console.log('Creating pet status window with message:', message);

  // 关闭已存在的小旅星窗口
  if (petStatusWindow && !petStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing pet status window');
    try {
      petStatusWindow.close();
      petStatusWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing pet status window:', error);
      petStatusWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newPetStatusWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 220,
    height: 120,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true,
    hasShadow: false
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.loadFile('petStatus.html');

  // 智能计算弹窗位置，避免被桌面边框遮挡
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 获取宠物窗口位置和大小
  let petPosition, petSize;

  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 强制刷新位置信息
      petPosition = petWindow.getPosition();
      petSize = petWindow.getSize();

      // 验证位置信息的有效性
      if (petPosition && Array.isArray(petPosition) && petPosition.length === 2 &&
        petSize && Array.isArray(petSize) && petSize.length === 2) {
        console.log('Pet window position:', petPosition, 'size:', petSize);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Invalid position or size data');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting pet window position:', error);
      petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
      petSize = [100, 100];
    }
  } else {
    petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
    petSize = [100, 100];
    console.log('Using default pet position:', petPosition);
  }

  // 气泡窗口的尺寸
  const bubbleWidth = 220;
  const bubbleHeight = 120;
  const bubbleTailHeight = 16; // 尾巴的高度

  // 计算最佳位置
  let bubbleX, bubbleY, bubbleDirection;

  // 计算桌宠中心位置
  const petCenterX = petPosition[0] + (petSize[0] / 2);
  const petCenterY = petPosition[1] + (petSize[1] / 2);

  // 优先尝试上方位置
  if (petPosition[1] >= bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 上方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  } else if (petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight <= screenHeight) {
    // 下方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'bottom';
  } else if (petPosition[0] >= bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 左侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] - bubbleWidth - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'left';
  } else if (petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight <= screenWidth) {
    // 右侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'right';
  } else {
    // 如果所有方向都没有足够空间，强制显示在上方
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2)));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight);
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  // 确保气泡不会超出屏幕边界
  bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, bubbleX));
  bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, bubbleY));

  // 验证计算出的位置是否合理
  const distanceFromPet = Math.sqrt(
    Math.pow(bubbleX + bubbleWidth / 2 - petCenterX, 2) +
    Math.pow(bubbleY + bubbleHeight / 2 - petCenterY, 2)
  );

  // 如果气泡距离桌宠太远（超过200像素），使用默认位置
  if (distanceFromPet > 200) {
    console.warn(`Bubble too far from pet (${distanceFromPet}px), using default position`);
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - bubbleWidth / 2));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, petCenterY - bubbleHeight / 2));
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  console.log(`Positioning bubble at (${bubbleX}, ${bubbleY}) with direction: ${bubbleDirection}`);
  console.log(`Pet center: (${petCenterX}, ${petCenterY}), Pet position: (${petPosition[0]}, ${petPosition[1]}), Pet size: (${petSize[0]}, ${petSize[1]})`);
  console.log(`Screen size: (${screenWidth}, ${screenHeight}), Bubble size: (${bubbleWidth}, ${bubbleHeight})`);
  console.log(`Distance from pet: ${distanceFromPet}px`);

  newPetStatusWindow.setPosition(Math.round(bubbleX), Math.round(bubbleY));

  // 通过IPC传递消息和气泡方向
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    try {
      console.log('Sending message and direction to status window:', message, bubbleDirection);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('update-status-message', message);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('set-bubble-direction', bubbleDirection);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending message to status window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听窗口错误
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Status window crashed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Status window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件
  newPetStatusWindow.on('closed', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window closed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口失去焦点事件（点击外部关闭）
  newPetStatusWindow.on('blur', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window lost focus, closing');
    if (newPetStatusWindow && !newPetStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      newPetStatusWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 保存到全局变量
  petStatusWindow = newPetStatusWindow;

  return newPetStatusWindow;
}

// 创建右键菜单窗口
function createContextMenuWindow(x, y, petPosition = [0, 0]) {
  // 关闭已存在的右键菜单
  if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing context menu window');
    try {
      contextMenuWindow.close();
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing context menu:', error);
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newContextMenuWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 180,
    height: 180,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true
  });

  newContextMenuWindow.loadFile('contextMenu.html');

  // 智能定位：避免被桌面边框遮挡，并根据桌宠位置优化显示方向
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 菜单尺寸
  const menuWidth = 180;
  const menuHeight = 180;

  // 计算最佳位置
  let finalX = x;
  let finalY = y;

  // 水平方向调整
  if (x + menuWidth > screenWidth) {
    finalX = screenWidth - menuWidth - 10;
  }
  if (finalX < 10) {
    finalX = 10;
  }

  // 垂直方向调整 - 优先显示在桌宠上方，如果空间不够则显示在下方
  const [petX, petY] = petPosition;
  const spaceAbove = y;
  const spaceBelow = screenHeight - y - menuHeight;

  if (spaceAbove >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 上方空间足够，显示在桌宠上方
    finalY = y - menuHeight - 10;
  } else if (spaceBelow >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 下方空间足够，显示在桌宠下方
    finalY = y + 20;
  } else {
    // 上下空间都不够，调整到屏幕边界内
    if (y + menuHeight > screenHeight) {
      finalY = screenHeight - menuHeight - 10;
    }
    if (finalY < 10) {
      finalY = 10;
    }
  }

  console.log(`Context menu positioning: original(${x}, ${y}), pet(${petX}, ${petY}) -> final(${finalX}, ${finalY})`);
  newContextMenuWindow.setPosition(finalX, finalY);

  // 错误处理
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Context menu window crashed');
  });
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Context menu window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件，清理全局变量
  newContextMenuWindow.on('closed', () => {
    contextMenuWindow = null;
    console.log('Context menu window closed, global variable cleared');
  });

  // 监听窗口即将关闭事件
  newContextMenuWindow.on('close', () => {
    console.log('Context menu window closing...');
  });

  // 自动关闭功能
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      if (newContextMenuWindow && !newContextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        console.log('Auto-closing context menu window');
        newContextMenuWindow.close();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error auto-closing context menu window:', error);
    }
  }, 5000); // 5秒后自动关闭

  // 更新全局变量
  contextMenuWindow = newContextMenuWindow;
  return newContextMenuWindow;
}

// 设置全局点击处理器来关闭右键菜单
function setupGlobalClickHandler() {
  if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    return;
  }

  console.log('Setting up global click handler for context menu');

  // 简化版本：直接使用定时器检查右键菜单状态
  const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      clearInterval(checkInterval);
      console.log('Context menu closed, clearing click handler');
    }
  }, 100);

  // 5秒后自动清理
  setTimeout(() => {
    clearInterval(checkInterval);
  }, 5000);
}

// 创建地图窗口
function createMapWindow(travelData = { origin: '武汉光谷', destination: '北京天安门' }) {
  console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);

  // 检查是否已存在地图窗口
  if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Map window already exists, showing and focusing');
    mapWindow.show();
    mapWindow.focus();
    return mapWindow;
  }

  // 清理旅行数据中的乱码字符
  const cleanTravelData = {
    origin: cleanText(travelData.origin) || '武汉光谷',
    destination: cleanText(travelData.destination) || '北京天安门',
    userLocation: travelData.userLocation || null
  };

  // 保存到全局变量
  globalTravelData = cleanTravelData;

  console.log('Cleaned travel data:', cleanTravelData);

  mapWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: false, // 与主页面保持一致
    transparent: false,
    resizable: true, // 允许调整大小
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    movable: true, // 允许窗口移动
    minimizable: true, // 允许最小化
    maximizable: true, // 允许最大化
    show: false // 初始不显示，等待加载完成后显示
  });

  mapWindow.loadFile('map.html');

  // 设置地图窗口位置到屏幕中央
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  mapWindow.setPosition(
    Math.round((width - 800) / 2),
    Math.round((height - 600) / 2)
  );

  // 通过IPC将高德地图API Key和旅行信息传递给地图窗口
  mapWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    // 传递API Key
    console.log('Passing API Key to map window');
    mapWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      window.AMAP_KEY = '${process.env.AMAP_KEY || ''}';
      console.log('API Key set in map window:', window.AMAP_KEY ? window.AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'Not set');
    `);

    // 发送旅行信息
    console.log('Sending travel info to map window');
    setTimeout(() => {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }, 1000);

    // 显示窗口
    mapWindow.show();
  });

  // 监听地图窗口关闭事件，改为隐藏而不是销毁
  mapWindow.on('close', (event) => {
    if (!app.isQuitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      mapWindow.hide();
      console.log('Map window hidden instead of closed');
    } else {
      // 应用退出时清理全局变量
      globalTravelData = null;
      console.log('App quitting, clearing global travel data');
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口请求旅行信息
  ipcMain.on('request-travel-info', () => {
    console.log('Map window requesting travel info');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口隐藏请求
  ipcMain.on('hide-map-window', () => {
    console.log('Hiding map window');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.hide();
    }
  });

  return mapWindow;
}

// 清理文本中的乱码字符
function cleanText(text) {
  if (!text) return text;

  // 移除常见的乱码字符
  return text.replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5\s\-_]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

// 创建通知气泡窗口
function createBubbleWindow(message) {
  bubbleWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 300,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: false, // 禁用透明度以提高兼容性
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    }
  });

  bubbleWindow.loadFile('bubble.html');

  // 通过IPC将AI生成的消息传递给气泡窗口
  bubbleWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    bubbleWindow.webContents.send('update-bubble-message', message);
  });

  return bubbleWindow;
}

// 截取屏幕截图
async function captureScreenshot() {
  try {
    console.log('📸 Capturing screenshot...');
    const sources = await desktopCapturer.getSources({
      types: ['screen'],
      thumbnailSize: { width: 800, height: 600 }
    });

    if (sources && sources.length > 0) {
      // 获取第一张屏幕截图
      const source = sources[0];
      const thumbnail = source.thumbnail;

      // 将截图转换为base64编码
      const base64Data = thumbnail.toDataURL().replace(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg);base64,/, '');
      console.log('📸 Screenshot captured, size:', base64Data.length, 'characters');

      // 使用AI分析截图内容
      console.log('🤖 Analyzing screenshot with AI...');
      const aiResponse = await analyzeScreenshot(base64Data);
      console.log('✅ AI analysis completed:', aiResponse);
      return aiResponse;
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No screen sources found');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Screenshot capture failed:', error);
  }

  // 如果出错，返回默认响应
  console.log('🔄 Returning fallback response');
  return {
    message: "替你去看北京天安门？",
    shouldTravel: true,
    confidence: 0.5
  };
}

// 注册全局快捷键监听截图
function registerScreenshotListener() {
  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F2');

    // 更改截图快捷键为F2
    const ret = globalShortcut.register('F2', async () => {
      console.log('Screenshot taken!');

      // 捕获并分析截图
      const aiResponse = await captureScreenshot();
      console.log('AI analysis result:', aiResponse);

      // 使用小旅星窗口显示AI回复
      createPetStatusWindow(aiResponse.message);

      // 如果AI判断需要触发旅行，则显示气泡提示
      if (aiResponse.shouldTravel) {
        // 显示AI生成的气泡提示
        setTimeout(() => {
          showScreenshotBubble(aiResponse.message);
        }, 1200);
      }

      // 切换宠物表情并设置状态复原
      if (aiResponse.emotion && petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        try {
          petWindow.webContents.send('change-emotion', aiResponse.emotion);
          console.log('Sent emotion change to pet:', aiResponse.emotion);

          // 设置状态并启动复原计时器
          setPetState(aiResponse.emotion);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to send emotion change:', error);
        }
      }
    });

    if (!ret) {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Screenshot listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F3');

    // 注册测试用快捷键
    const ret2 = globalShortcut.register('F3', async () => {
      console.log('Manual water reminder triggered!');
      createWaterReminderWindow();
    });

    if (!ret2) {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Water reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F4');

    // 注册另一个测试用快捷键
    const ret3 = globalShortcut.register('F4', async () => {
      console.log('Manual fun reminder triggered!');
      // 生成AI趣味提醒
      const funMessage = await generateFunReminder();
      createPetStatusWindow(funMessage);
    });

    if (!ret3) {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Fun reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F6');

    // 注册手动重置状态快捷键
    const ret4 = globalShortcut.register('F6', () => {
      console.log('Manual reset pet state triggered!');
      resetPetState();
    });

    if (!ret4) {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Reset pet state listener registration error:', error);
  }
}

// 显示截图响应气泡（放置在右上角）
function showScreenshotBubble(message) {
  const bubbleWindow = createBubbleWindow(message);

  // 设置气泡窗口位置到屏幕右上角（避免遮挡通知区域）
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  bubbleWindow.setPosition(
    width - 310,
    150 // 距离顶部150像素，避免遮挡Windows通知
  );

  // 10秒后自动关闭
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (bubbleWindow && !bubbleWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      bubbleWindow.close();
    }
  }, 10000);
}

// IPC事件处理：开始旅程
ipcMain.on('start-journey', async (event, data) => {
  console.log('Starting journey to:', data.destination);

  // 提取目的地信息（从AI回复中提取地点名）
  let destination = '北京天安门';
  if (data.destination) {
    // 尝试从"替你去看[地点]？"格式中提取地点
    const match = data.destination.match(/替你去看(.+)[？\?]/);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      destination = match[1];
    } else {
      destination = data.destination;
    }
  }

  try {
    // 获取用户当前位置作为起点
    console.log('Getting user current location...');
    const userLocation = await amapService.getUserLocationDetails();
    console.log('User location info:', userLocation);

    // 创建地图窗口并传递旅行数据
    const travelData = {
      origin: `${userLocation.city}`,
      destination: destination,
      userLocation: userLocation
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get user location, using default location:', error);

    // 如果获取用户位置失败，使用默认位置
    const travelData = {
      origin: '武汉光谷',
      destination: destination
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    console.log('Using default location to create map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  }

  // 可以在这里添加更多旅程启动逻辑
});

// 设置桌宠状态并启动复原计时器
function setPetState(emotion) {
  // 清除之前的计时器
  if (petStateTimer) {
    clearTimeout(petStateTimer);
  }

  currentPetEmotion = emotion;
  console.log('设置桌宠状态:', emotion);

  // 设置复原计时器
  petStateTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    resetPetState();
  }, PET_STATE_DURATION);
}

// 重置桌宠状态为初始状态
function resetPetState() {
  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 发送重置状态信号给渲染进程
      petWindow.webContents.send('reset-emotion');
      console.log('重置桌宠状态为初始状态');

      // 清除状态记录
      currentPetEmotion = null;
      if (petStateTimer) {
        clearTimeout(petStateTimer);
        petStateTimer = null;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('重置桌宠状态失败:', error);
    }
  }
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>DeskPet</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: transparent;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            -webkit-app-region: drag;
            /* 添加拖动区域 */
        }

        .pet-container {
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
            /* 点击区域不拖动 */
            position: fixed;
            z-index: 10;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            /* 初始位置在右下角 */
            right: 20px;
            bottom: 20px;
        }

        .pet-container:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .pet-container:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .pet-image {
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
            border-radius: 50%;
            object-fit: cover;
            pointer-events: none;
            /* 确保点击事件传递给父容器 */
            user-select: none;
            /* 防止图片被选中 */
        }



        /* 拖拽提示 */
        .pet-container::after {
            content: '↕';
            position: absolute;
            top: -15px;
            right: -15px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #999;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        /* 吸附动画 */
        @keyframes snap-bounce {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1.2);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        @keyframes snap-scale {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1.1);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        /* 返回动画 */
        @keyframes return-walk {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }

            25% {
                transform: scale(1.1) translateX(-5px);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }

            75% {
                transform: scale(1.1) translateX(5px);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }

    </style>

        <img class="pet-image" id="petImage" src="assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/pet.gif" alt="桌宠" />
    </div>



    <script>
        const pet = document.getElementById('pet');
        const petImage = document.getElementById('petImage');

        // 表情映射表
        const emotionMap = {
            '好棒': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/好棒.gif',
            '嘿嘿被夸了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/嘿嘿被夸了.gif',
            '给你花花': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/给你花花.gif',
            '有瓜让我听听': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/有瓜让我听听.gif',
            '猫头偷看': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/猫头偷看.gif',
            '思考并怀疑': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/思考并怀疑.gif',
            '好复杂': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/好复杂.gif',
            '馋得流口水': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/馋得流口水.gif',
            '生气替你出头': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/生气替你出头.gif',
            '哼不理你了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/哼不理你了.gif',
            '玩手机': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/玩手机.gif',
            '困死了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/困死了.gif'
        };

        // 根据时间切换默认表情
        function updateDefaultEmotion() {
            const now = new Date();
            const hour = now.getHours();

            if (hour >= 18) { // 晚上6点后
                petImage.src = 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/困死了.gif';
                console.log('晚上时间，切换到困死了.gif');
            } else {
                petImage.src = 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/pet.gif'; // 默认的 so hot
                console.log('白天时间，使用默认pet.gif');
            }
        }

        // 切换表情函数
        function changeEmotion(emotion) {
            if (emotionMap[emotion]) {
                petImage.src = emotionMap[emotion];
                console.log('切换到表情:', emotion);
            } else {
                console.log('未知表情:', emotion);
            }
        }

        // 初始化时设置默认表情
        updateDefaultEmotion();

        // 右键菜单功能
        let contextMenuTimeout = null;
        pet.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            // 防抖：清除之前的超时
            if (contextMenuTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(contextMenuTimeout);
            }

            // 延迟发送，避免快速连续点击
            contextMenuTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                    console.log('Sending context menu request');
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('show-context-menu', e.screenX, e.screenY);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error showing context menu:', error);
                }
            }, 50);
        });

        // 点击和长按区分功能
        let isDragging = false;
        let lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0; // 上一次鼠标位置
        let offsetX, offsetY; // 鼠标在窗口内的偏移位置
        let lastMoveTime = 0; // 上次移动时间
        const moveThreshold = 1; // 移动阈值（像素）
        let isFlipped = false; // 记录翻转状态

        // 长按检测相关变量
        let longPressTimer = null;
        let isLongPress = false;
        const longPressDelay = 50; // 长按触发时间（毫秒）
        let hasMoved = false; // 是否已经移动过

        // 整个宠物容器都可以拖拽
        pet.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            // 只有左键拖拽
            if (e.button !== 0) return;

            e.preventDefault(); // 防止默认行为

            // 重置状态
            isDragging = false;
            isLongPress = false;
            hasMoved = false;

            // 记录鼠标在窗口内的点击位置
            offsetX = e.clientX;
            offsetY = e.clientY;

            // 记录当前鼠标屏幕位置
            lastMouseX = e.screenX;
            lastMouseY = e.screenY;
            lastMoveTime = Date.now();

            // 开始长按计时器
            longPressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (!hasMoved) {
                    isLongPress = true;
                    isDragging = true;

                    // 开始拖拽时重置翻转状态
                    if (isFlipped) {
                        isFlipped = false;
                        pet.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                        console.log('长按拖拽开始，重置翻转状态');
                    }

                    pet.style.cursor = 'grabbing';

                    // 通知主进程开始拖动，并传递偏移量
                    try {
                        require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-start', { offsetX, offsetY });
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('发送拖动开始信号失败:', error);
                    }

                    console.log('长按开始拖拽宠物');
                }
            }, longPressDelay);
        });

        // 鼠标移动事件
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            // 检查是否移动超过阈值
            const deltaX = e.screenX - lastMouseX;
            const deltaY = e.screenY - lastMouseY;

            if (Math.abs(deltaX) > moveThreshold || Math.abs(deltaY) > moveThreshold) {
                hasMoved = true;

                // 如果移动了，取消长按计时器
                if (longPressTimer) {
                    clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                    longPressTimer = null;
                }
            }

            if (!isDragging) return;

            // 检查是否移动超过阈值，并且最小时间间隔
            const now = Date.now();
            const timeDelta = now - lastMoveTime;

            if ((Math.abs(deltaX) > moveThreshold || Math.abs(deltaY) > moveThreshold) && timeDelta > 16) {
                // 更新上次移动时间
                lastMoveTime = now;

                // 更新上次鼠标位置
                lastMouseX = e.screenX;
                lastMouseY = e.screenY;

                // 直接发送鼠标的绝对位置给主进程
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('move-pet-absolute', {
                        mouseX: e.screenX,
                        mouseY: e.screenY
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送鼠标位置失败:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 鼠标释放事件
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            // 清除长按计时器
            if (longPressTimer) {
                clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                longPressTimer = null;
            }

            if (isDragging) {
                console.log('结束拖拽宠物');
                isDragging = false;
                isLongPress = false;
                pet.style.cursor = 'pointer';

                // 通知主进程结束拖动
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-end');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送拖拽结束信号失败:', error);
                }
            } else if (!hasMoved) {
                // 如果没有移动且没有长按，则触发点击事件
                console.log('Pet clicked, triggering fun reminder');
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('pet-clicked');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error sending pet click event:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 确保鼠标离开窗口时也能正确处理拖动结束
        document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            // 清除长按计时器
            if (longPressTimer) {
                clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                longPressTimer = null;
            }

            if (isDragging) {
                console.log('鼠标离开窗口，结束拖拽');
                isDragging = false;
                isLongPress = false;
                pet.style.cursor = 'pointer';

                // 通知主进程结束拖动
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-end');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送拖拽结束信号失败:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 防止拖拽时选中文本
        pet.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
            if (isDragging) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });

        // 监听窗口位置更新（保留用于其他功能）
        const { ipcRenderer } = require('electron');
        ipcRenderer.on('pet-window-position', (event, x, y) => {
            // 保留此监听器用于其他功能，但不再用于拖动
        });

        // 监听边缘吸附完成事件 - 暂时注释掉
        /*
        ipcRenderer.on('snap-completed', (event, x, y, snapType, shouldFlip) => {
            console.log('边缘吸附完成:', x, y, snapType, shouldFlip);

            // 处理翻转
            if (shouldFlip) {
                isFlipped = true;
                pet.style.transform = 'scaleY(-1)';
                console.log('宠物已翻转（吸附到顶部）');
            } else {
                isFlipped = false;
            }

            // 添加吸附完成的视觉反馈和动画
            pet.style.transform = shouldFlip ? 'scale(1.1) scaleY(-1)' : 'scale(1.1)';
            pet.style.transition = 'transform 0.2s ease-out';

            // 吸附动画效果 - 只进行屏幕边缘吸附

            setTimeout(() => {

                pet.style.transition = 'transform 0.1s ease-in';
                pet.style.animation = '';
            }, 200);
        });
        */

        // 监听返回原位置事件
        ipcRenderer.on('return-to-original', (event) => {
            console.log('开始返回原位置');

            // 重置翻转状态
            if (isFlipped) {
                isFlipped = false;
                pet.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }

            // 添加返回动画效果
            pet.style.animation = 'return-walk 1s ease-in-out';
        });

        // 监听返回完成事件
        ipcRenderer.on('return-completed', (event) => {
            console.log('返回原位置完成');

            // 清除动画
            pet.style.animation = '';
        });





        // 监听表情切换事件
        try {
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.on('change-emotion', (event, emotion) => {
                changeEmotion(emotion);
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error setting up emotion listener:', error);
        }

        // 监听状态复原事件
        try {
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.on('reset-emotion', (event) => {
                console.log('收到状态复原信号，恢复初始状态');
                updateDefaultEmotion();
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error setting up reset emotion listener:', error);
        }

        console.log('Pet with drag and emotion support loaded');
    </script>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>DeskPet</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: transparent;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            -webkit-app-region: drag;
            /* 添加拖动区域 */
        }

        .pet-container {
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            -webkit-app-region: no-drag;
            /* 点击区域不拖动 */
            position: fixed;
            z-index: 10;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            /* 初始位置在右下角 */
            right: 20px;
            bottom: 20px;
        }

        .pet-container:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .pet-container:active {
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }

        .pet-image {
            width: 80px;
            height: 80px;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
            border-radius: 50%;
            object-fit: cover;
            pointer-events: none;
            /* 确保点击事件传递给父容器 */
            user-select: none;
            /* 防止图片被选中 */
        }



        /* 拖拽提示 */
        .pet-container::after {
            content: '↕';
            position: absolute;
            top: -15px;
            right: -15px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #999;
            pointer-events: none;
            opacity: 0.6;
        }

        /* 吸附动画 */
        @keyframes snap-bounce {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1.2);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        @keyframes snap-scale {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1.1);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
        }

        /* 返回动画 */
        @keyframes return-walk {
            0% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }

            25% {
                transform: scale(1.1) translateX(-5px);
            }

            50% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }

            75% {
                transform: scale(1.1) translateX(5px);
            }

            100% {
                transform: scale(1) translateX(0);
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

    </div>



    <script>
        const pet = document.getElementById('pet');
        const petImage = document.getElementById('petImage');

        // 表情映射表
        const emotionMap = {
            '好棒': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/好棒.gif',
            '嘿嘿被夸了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/嘿嘿被夸了.gif',
            '给你花花': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/给你花花.gif',
            '有瓜让我听听': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/有瓜让我听听.gif',
            '猫头偷看': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/猫头偷看.gif',
            '思考并怀疑': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/思考并怀疑.gif',
            '好复杂': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/好复杂.gif',
            '馋得流口水': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/馋得流口水.gif',
            '生气替你出头': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/生气替你出头.gif',
            '哼不理你了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/哼不理你了.gif',
            '玩手机': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/玩手机.gif',
            '困死了': 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/困死了.gif'
        };

        // 根据时间切换默认表情
        function updateDefaultEmotion() {
            const now = new Date();
            const hour = now.getHours();

            if (hour >= 18) { // 晚上6点后
                petImage.src = 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/困死了.gif';
                console.log('晚上时间，切换到困死了.gif');
            } else {
                petImage.src = 'assets/imgs/罗小黑的生活/pet.gif'; // 默认的 so hot
                console.log('白天时间，使用默认pet.gif');
            }
        }

        // 切换表情函数
        function changeEmotion(emotion) {
            if (emotionMap[emotion]) {
                petImage.src = emotionMap[emotion];
                console.log('切换到表情:', emotion);
            } else {
                console.log('未知表情:', emotion);
            }
        }

        // 初始化时设置默认表情
        updateDefaultEmotion();

        // 右键菜单功能
        let contextMenuTimeout = null;
        pet.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            // 防抖：清除之前的超时
            if (contextMenuTimeout) {
                clearTimeout(contextMenuTimeout);
            }

            // 延迟发送，避免快速连续点击
            contextMenuTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                try {
                    console.log('Sending context menu request');
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('show-context-menu', e.screenX, e.screenY);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error showing context menu:', error);
                }
            }, 50);
        });

        // 点击和长按区分功能
        let isDragging = false;
        let lastMouseX = 0, lastMouseY = 0; // 上一次鼠标位置
        let offsetX, offsetY; // 鼠标在窗口内的偏移位置
        let lastMoveTime = 0; // 上次移动时间
        const moveThreshold = 1; // 移动阈值（像素）
        let isFlipped = false; // 记录翻转状态

        // 长按检测相关变量
        let longPressTimer = null;
        let isLongPress = false;
        const longPressDelay = 50; // 长按触发时间（毫秒）
        let hasMoved = false; // 是否已经移动过

        // 整个宠物容器都可以拖拽
        pet.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            // 只有左键拖拽
            if (e.button !== 0) return;

            e.preventDefault(); // 防止默认行为

            // 重置状态
            isDragging = false;
            isLongPress = false;
            hasMoved = false;

            // 记录鼠标在窗口内的点击位置
            offsetX = e.clientX;
            offsetY = e.clientY;

            // 记录当前鼠标屏幕位置
            lastMouseX = e.screenX;
            lastMouseY = e.screenY;
            lastMoveTime = Date.now();

            // 开始长按计时器
            longPressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                if (!hasMoved) {
                    isLongPress = true;
                    isDragging = true;

                    // 开始拖拽时重置翻转状态
                    if (isFlipped) {
                        isFlipped = false;
                        pet.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                        console.log('长按拖拽开始，重置翻转状态');
                    }

                    pet.style.cursor = 'grabbing';

                    // 通知主进程开始拖动，并传递偏移量
                    try {
                        require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-start', { offsetX, offsetY });
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('发送拖动开始信号失败:', error);
                    }

                    console.log('长按开始拖拽宠物');
                }
            }, longPressDelay);
        });

        // 鼠标移动事件
        document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            // 检查是否移动超过阈值
            const deltaX = e.screenX - lastMouseX;
            const deltaY = e.screenY - lastMouseY;

            if (Math.abs(deltaX) > moveThreshold || Math.abs(deltaY) > moveThreshold) {
                hasMoved = true;

                // 如果移动了，取消长按计时器
                if (longPressTimer) {
                    clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                    longPressTimer = null;
                }
            }

            if (!isDragging) return;

            // 检查是否移动超过阈值，并且最小时间间隔
            const now = Date.now();
            const timeDelta = now - lastMoveTime;

            if ((Math.abs(deltaX) > moveThreshold || Math.abs(deltaY) > moveThreshold) && timeDelta > 16) {
                // 更新上次移动时间
                lastMoveTime = now;

                // 更新上次鼠标位置
                lastMouseX = e.screenX;
                lastMouseY = e.screenY;

                // 直接发送鼠标的绝对位置给主进程
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('move-pet-absolute', {
                        mouseX: e.screenX,
                        mouseY: e.screenY
                    });
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送鼠标位置失败:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 鼠标释放事件
        document.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
            // 清除长按计时器
            if (longPressTimer) {
                clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                longPressTimer = null;
            }

            if (isDragging) {
                console.log('结束拖拽宠物');
                isDragging = false;
                isLongPress = false;
                pet.style.cursor = 'pointer';

                // 通知主进程结束拖动
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-end');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送拖拽结束信号失败:', error);
                }
            } else if (!hasMoved) {
                // 如果没有移动且没有长按，则触发点击事件
                console.log('Pet clicked, triggering fun reminder');
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('pet-clicked');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error sending pet click event:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 确保鼠标离开窗口时也能正确处理拖动结束
        document.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            // 清除长按计时器
            if (longPressTimer) {
                clearTimeout(longPressTimer);
                longPressTimer = null;
            }

            if (isDragging) {
                console.log('鼠标离开窗口，结束拖拽');
                isDragging = false;
                isLongPress = false;
                pet.style.cursor = 'pointer';

                // 通知主进程结束拖动
                try {
                    require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('drag-end');
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('发送拖拽结束信号失败:', error);
                }
            }
        });

        // 防止拖拽时选中文本
        pet.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
            if (isDragging) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        });

        // 监听窗口位置更新（保留用于其他功能）
        const { ipcRenderer } = require('electron');
        ipcRenderer.on('pet-window-position', (event, x, y) => {
            // 保留此监听器用于其他功能，但不再用于拖动
        });

        // 监听边缘吸附完成事件 - 暂时注释掉
        /*

            console.log('边缘吸附完成:', x, y, snapType, shouldFlip);

            // 处理翻转
            if (shouldFlip) {

        });
        */

        // 监听返回原位置事件 - 暂时注释掉

        });

        // 监听返回完成事件
        ipcRenderer.on('return-completed', (event) => {
            console.log('返回原位置完成');

            // 清除动画

        });
        */





        // 监听表情切换事件
        try {
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.on('change-emotion', (event, emotion) => {
                changeEmotion(emotion);
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error setting up emotion listener:', error);
        }

        // 监听状态复原事件
        try {
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.on('reset-emotion', (event) => {
                console.log('收到状态复原信号，恢复初始状态');
                updateDefaultEmotion();
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error setting up reset emotion listener:', error);
        }

        console.log('Pet with drag and emotion support loaded');
    </script>

function createPetWindow() {

    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,

    },

  });

  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  petWindow.setPosition(
    width - 120,
    height - 120
  );

  // 允许鼠标事件，但不穿透
  petWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);

              '正在冰岛看极光✨',

            ];
            const message = messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)];
            console.log('Pet clicked, sending message:', message);
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('pet-clicked', message);
          });
          console.log('Pet click event listener added successfully');
        } else {
          console.error('Pet element not found');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error setting up pet click listener:', error);
      }
    `).catch(error => {

  });

  // 监听退出应用事件
  ipcMain.on('exit-app', (event) => {
    console.log('Exiting app from context menu');
    try {
      app.isQuitting = true;
      app.quit();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exiting app:', error);
    }

  // 监听显示右键菜单事件

// 创建宠物状态弹窗窗口
function createPetStatusWindow(message) {
  console.log('Creating pet status window with message:', message);

  // 关闭已存在的小旅星窗口
  if (petStatusWindow && !petStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing pet status window');
    try {
      petStatusWindow.close();
      petStatusWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing pet status window:', error);
      petStatusWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newPetStatusWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 220,
    height: 120,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true,
    hasShadow: false
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.loadFile('petStatus.html');

  // 智能计算弹窗位置，避免被桌面边框遮挡
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 获取宠物窗口位置和大小
  let petPosition, petSize;

  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 强制刷新位置信息
      petPosition = petWindow.getPosition();
      petSize = petWindow.getSize();

      // 验证位置信息的有效性
      if (petPosition && Array.isArray(petPosition) && petPosition.length === 2 &&
        petSize && Array.isArray(petSize) && petSize.length === 2) {
        console.log('Pet window position:', petPosition, 'size:', petSize);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Invalid position or size data');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting pet window position:', error);
      petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
      petSize = [100, 100];
    }
  } else {
    petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
    petSize = [100, 100];
    console.log('Using default pet position:', petPosition);
  }

  // 气泡窗口的尺寸
  const bubbleWidth = 220;
  const bubbleHeight = 120;
  const bubbleTailHeight = 16; // 尾巴的高度

  // 计算最佳位置
  let bubbleX, bubbleY, bubbleDirection;

  // 计算桌宠中心位置
  const petCenterX = petPosition[0] + (petSize[0] / 2);
  const petCenterY = petPosition[1] + (petSize[1] / 2);

  // 优先尝试上方位置
  if (petPosition[1] >= bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 上方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  } else if (petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight <= screenHeight) {
    // 下方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'bottom';
  } else if (petPosition[0] >= bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 左侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] - bubbleWidth - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'left';
  } else if (petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight <= screenWidth) {
    // 右侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'right';
  } else {
    // 如果所有方向都没有足够空间，强制显示在上方
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2)));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight);
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  // 确保气泡不会超出屏幕边界
  bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, bubbleX));
  bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, bubbleY));

  // 验证计算出的位置是否合理
  const distanceFromPet = Math.sqrt(
    Math.pow(bubbleX + bubbleWidth / 2 - petCenterX, 2) +
    Math.pow(bubbleY + bubbleHeight / 2 - petCenterY, 2)
  );

  // 如果气泡距离桌宠太远（超过200像素），使用默认位置
  if (distanceFromPet > 200) {
    console.warn(`Bubble too far from pet (${distanceFromPet}px), using default position`);
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - bubbleWidth / 2));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, petCenterY - bubbleHeight / 2));
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  console.log(`Positioning bubble at (${bubbleX}, ${bubbleY}) with direction: ${bubbleDirection}`);
  console.log(`Pet center: (${petCenterX}, ${petCenterY}), Pet position: (${petPosition[0]}, ${petPosition[1]}), Pet size: (${petSize[0]}, ${petSize[1]})`);
  console.log(`Screen size: (${screenWidth}, ${screenHeight}), Bubble size: (${bubbleWidth}, ${bubbleHeight})`);
  console.log(`Distance from pet: ${distanceFromPet}px`);

  newPetStatusWindow.setPosition(Math.round(bubbleX), Math.round(bubbleY));

  // 通过IPC传递消息和气泡方向
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    try {
      console.log('Sending message and direction to status window:', message, bubbleDirection);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('update-status-message', message);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('set-bubble-direction', bubbleDirection);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending message to status window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听窗口错误
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Status window crashed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Status window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件
  newPetStatusWindow.on('closed', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window closed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口失去焦点事件（点击外部关闭）
  newPetStatusWindow.on('blur', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window lost focus, closing');
    if (newPetStatusWindow && !newPetStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      newPetStatusWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 保存到全局变量
  petStatusWindow = newPetStatusWindow;

  return newPetStatusWindow;
}

// 创建右键菜单窗口
function createContextMenuWindow(x, y, petPosition = [0, 0]) {
  // 关闭已存在的右键菜单
  if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing context menu window');
    try {
      contextMenuWindow.close();
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing context menu:', error);
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newContextMenuWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 180,
    height: 180,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true
  });

  newContextMenuWindow.loadFile('contextMenu.html');

  // 智能定位：避免被桌面边框遮挡，并根据桌宠位置优化显示方向
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 菜单尺寸
  const menuWidth = 180;
  const menuHeight = 180;

  // 计算最佳位置
  let finalX = x;
  let finalY = y;

  // 水平方向调整
  if (x + menuWidth > screenWidth) {
    finalX = screenWidth - menuWidth - 10;
  }
  if (finalX < 10) {
    finalX = 10;
  }

  // 垂直方向调整 - 优先显示在桌宠上方，如果空间不够则显示在下方
  const [petX, petY] = petPosition;
  const spaceAbove = y;
  const spaceBelow = screenHeight - y - menuHeight;

  if (spaceAbove >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 上方空间足够，显示在桌宠上方
    finalY = y - menuHeight - 10;
  } else if (spaceBelow >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 下方空间足够，显示在桌宠下方
    finalY = y + 20;
  } else {
    // 上下空间都不够，调整到屏幕边界内
    if (y + menuHeight > screenHeight) {
      finalY = screenHeight - menuHeight - 10;
    }
    if (finalY < 10) {
      finalY = 10;
    }
  }

  console.log(`Context menu positioning: original(${x}, ${y}), pet(${petX}, ${petY}) -> final(${finalX}, ${finalY})`);
  newContextMenuWindow.setPosition(finalX, finalY);

  // 错误处理
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Context menu window crashed');
  });
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Context menu window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件，清理全局变量
  newContextMenuWindow.on('closed', () => {
    contextMenuWindow = null;
    console.log('Context menu window closed, global variable cleared');
  });

  // 监听窗口即将关闭事件
  newContextMenuWindow.on('close', () => {
    console.log('Context menu window closing...');
  });

  // 自动关闭功能
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      if (newContextMenuWindow && !newContextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        console.log('Auto-closing context menu window');
        newContextMenuWindow.close();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error auto-closing context menu window:', error);
    }
  }, 5000); // 5秒后自动关闭

  // 更新全局变量
  contextMenuWindow = newContextMenuWindow;
  return newContextMenuWindow;
}

// 设置全局点击处理器来关闭右键菜单
function setupGlobalClickHandler() {
  if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    return;
  }

  console.log('Setting up global click handler for context menu');

  // 简化版本：直接使用定时器检查右键菜单状态
  const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      clearInterval(checkInterval);
      console.log('Context menu closed, clearing click handler');
    }
  }, 100);

  // 5秒后自动清理
  setTimeout(() => {
    clearInterval(checkInterval);
  }, 5000);
}

// 创建地图窗口
function createMapWindow(travelData = { origin: '武汉光谷', destination: '北京天安门' }) {
  console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);

  // 检查是否已存在地图窗口
  if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Map window already exists, showing and focusing');
    mapWindow.show();
    mapWindow.focus();
    return mapWindow;
  }

  // 清理旅行数据中的乱码字符
  const cleanTravelData = {
    origin: cleanText(travelData.origin) || '武汉光谷',
    destination: cleanText(travelData.destination) || '北京天安门',
    userLocation: travelData.userLocation || null
  };

  // 保存到全局变量
  globalTravelData = cleanTravelData;

  console.log('Cleaned travel data:', cleanTravelData);

  mapWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: false, // 与主页面保持一致
    transparent: false,
    resizable: true, // 允许调整大小
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    movable: true, // 允许窗口移动
    minimizable: true, // 允许最小化
    maximizable: true, // 允许最大化
    show: false // 初始不显示，等待加载完成后显示
  });

  mapWindow.loadFile('map.html');

  // 设置地图窗口位置到屏幕中央
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  mapWindow.setPosition(
    Math.round((width - 800) / 2),
    Math.round((height - 600) / 2)
  );

  // 通过IPC将高德地图API Key和旅行信息传递给地图窗口
  mapWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    // 传递API Key
    console.log('Passing API Key to map window');
    mapWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      window.AMAP_KEY = '${process.env.AMAP_KEY || ''}';
      console.log('API Key set in map window:', window.AMAP_KEY ? window.AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'Not set');
    `);

    // 发送旅行信息
    console.log('Sending travel info to map window');
    setTimeout(() => {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }, 1000);

    // 显示窗口
    mapWindow.show();
  });

  // 监听地图窗口关闭事件，改为隐藏而不是销毁
  mapWindow.on('close', (event) => {
    if (!app.isQuitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      mapWindow.hide();
      console.log('Map window hidden instead of closed');
    } else {
      // 应用退出时清理全局变量
      globalTravelData = null;
      console.log('App quitting, clearing global travel data');
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口请求旅行信息
  ipcMain.on('request-travel-info', () => {
    console.log('Map window requesting travel info');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口隐藏请求
  ipcMain.on('hide-map-window', () => {
    console.log('Hiding map window');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.hide();
    }
  });

  return mapWindow;
}

// 清理文本中的乱码字符
function cleanText(text) {
  if (!text) return text;

  // 移除常见的乱码字符
  return text.replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5\s\-_]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

// 创建通知气泡窗口
function createBubbleWindow(message) {
  bubbleWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 300,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: false, // 禁用透明度以提高兼容性
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    }
  });

  bubbleWindow.loadFile('bubble.html');

  // 通过IPC将AI生成的消息传递给气泡窗口
  bubbleWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    bubbleWindow.webContents.send('update-bubble-message', message);
  });

  return bubbleWindow;
}
