现在修改开始旅行的函数，初始化旅行状态：

```javascript
// 加载环境变量
require('dotenv').config();

const { app, BrowserWindow, globalShortcut, desktopCapturer, Notification, ipcMain, Menu } = require('electron');
const path = require('path');
const { ActivityMonitor, setCreatePetStatusWindowFunction } = require('./activityMonitor');
const { analyzeScreenshot, generateFunReminder, generateJourneyStatus } = require('./aiService');
const AMapService = require('./amapService');
const weatherService = require('./weatherService');

// 禁用GPU加速以解决Passthrough错误
app.disableHardwareAcceleration();

// 设置应用用户模型ID，解决Windows通知问题
app.setAppUserModelId("com.desktripper.app");

// 禁用默认菜单栏
Menu.setApplicationMenu(null);

// 设置Electron缓存目录，解决权限问题
app.setPath('userData', path.join(app.getPath('appData'), 'DeskTripper'));

let mainWindow;
let mapWindow;
let bubbleWindow;
let waterReminderWindow;
let petWindow;
let contextMenuWindow = null;
let transparencyWindow = null; // 添加右键菜单窗口跟踪

// 拖动相关变量
let isDragging = false;
let dragOffset = { x: 0, y: 0 };

// 吸附状态管理 - 暂时注释掉
// let isSnapped = false;
// let snapInfo = {
//   type: '',
//   position: null,
//   attachedWindow: null
// };

// 桌宠状态管理
let petStateTimer = null;
let currentPetEmotion = null;
const PET_STATE_DURATION = 5000; // 状态持续时间（毫秒）

// 全局旅行数据
let globalTravelData = null;

// 旅行状态管理
let currentTravelStatus = {
  isInProgress: false,
  currentLocation: null,
  currentWeather: null,
  lastCity: null,
  totalDistance: 0,
  traveledDistance: 0,
  progress: 0
};

// 小旅星窗口管理
let petStatusWindow = null;
let activityMonitor;
let amapService;

// 创建主窗口
function createMainWindow() {
  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    autoHideMenuBar: true // 隐藏菜单栏
  });

  // 加载主界面
  mainWindow.loadFile('index.html');

  // 监听窗口关闭事件，隐藏而不是销毁
  mainWindow.on('close', (event) => {
    if (!app.isQuitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      mainWindow.hide();
    }
  });

  // 监听窗口中的用户活动
  mainWindow.webContents.on('dom-ready', () => {
    // 注入活动监听脚本
    mainWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', () => {
        require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('user-activity');
      });
      
      document.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
        require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('user-activity');
      });
    `);
  });
}

// 创建宠物窗口
function createPetWindow() {
  petWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true, // 不在任务栏显示
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    movable: true, // 允许窗口移动
    focusable: true // 允许窗口获得焦点
  });

  petWindow.loadFile('pet.html');

  // 设置宠物窗口初始位置到右下角
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  petWindow.setPosition(
    width - 120,
    height - 120
  );

  // 允许鼠标事件，但不穿透
  petWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);

  // 设置窗口可以拖拽
  petWindow.setMovable(true);

  // 监听宠物点击事件
  petWindow.webContents.on('dom-ready', () => {
    petWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      try {
        const pet = document.getElementById('pet');
        if (pet) {
          pet.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const messages = [
              '正在冰岛看极光✨',
              '在挪威森林里探险🌲',
              '于撒哈拉沙漠看星星🌟',
              '在日本樱花树下喝茶🌸',
              '在瑞士阿尔卑斯山滑雪⛷️'
            ];
            const message = messages[Math.floor(Math.random() * messages.length)];
            console.log('Pet clicked, sending message:', message);
            require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('pet-clicked', message);
          });
          console.log('Pet click event listener added successfully');
        } else {
          console.error('Pet element not found');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error setting up pet click listener:', error);
      }
    `).catch(error => {
      console.error('Error executing JavaScript in pet window:', error);
    });
  });

  // 监听宠物点击事件 - 触发趣味提醒
  ipcMain.on('pet-clicked', async (event) => {
    console.log('Pet clicked, triggering fun reminder');
    try {
      // 生成AI趣味提醒
      const funMessage = await generateFunReminder();
      createPetStatusWindow(funMessage);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating fun reminder:', error);
      // 如果生成失败，显示默认消息
      createPetStatusWindow('今天也要开开心心的哦！✨');
    }
  });

  // 监听打开主窗口事件
  ipcMain.on('open-main-window', (event) => {
    console.log('Opening main window from pet context menu');
    try {
      if (mainWindow && !mainWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        mainWindow.show();
        mainWindow.focus();
      } else {
        createMainWindow();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error opening main window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听退出应用事件
  ipcMain.on('exit-app', (event) => {
    console.log('Exiting app from context menu');
    try {
      app.isQuitting = true;
      app.quit();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error exiting app:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听显示右键菜单事件
  ipcMain.on('show-context-menu', (event, x, y) => {
    console.log('Showing context menu at:', x, y);
    try {
      // 获取桌宠窗口位置来优化菜单显示方向
      const petPosition = petWindow ? petWindow.getPosition() : [0, 0];
      createContextMenuWindow(x, y, petPosition);

      // 设置全局点击监听器来关闭右键菜单
      setTimeout(() => {
        setupGlobalClickHandler();
      }, 100);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating context menu window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听获取宠物窗口位置事件
  ipcMain.on('get-pet-window-position', (event) => {
    if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      try {
        const [x, y] = petWindow.getPosition();
        event.reply('pet-window-position', x, y);
        console.log('获取宠物窗口位置:', x, y);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('获取宠物窗口位置失败:', error);
      }
    }
  });

  // 监听拖动开始事件
  ipcMain.on('drag-start', (event, { offsetX, offsetY }) => {
    console.log('Drag started with offset:', offsetX, offsetY);
    isDragging = true;
    dragOffset = { x: offsetX, y: offsetY };

    // 拖动开始时清除吸附状态，确保正常拖动 - 暂时注释掉
    /*
    if (isSnapped) {
      console.log('拖动开始，清除吸附状态');
      isSnapped = false;
      snapInfo = {
        type: '',
        position: null,
        attachedWindow: null
      };
      
      // 清除吸附窗口记录
      if (petWindow && petWindow.attachedToWindow) {
        delete petWindow.attachedToWindow;
      }
    }
    */

    // 临时禁用点击穿透，允许拖动
    if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      petWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);
      // 确保窗口可以接收鼠标事件
      petWindow.setMovable(true);
      petWindow.setFocusable(true);
    }
  });

  // 监听绝对位置移动 - 简化版本，只设置位置不记录日志
  ipcMain.on('move-pet-absolute', (event, { mouseX, mouseY }) => {
    if (petWindow && isDragging) {
      // 拖动过程中直接设置位置，不进行任何检查或记录
      const newX = Math.round(mouseX - dragOffset.x);
      const newY = Math.round(mouseY - dragOffset.y);
      petWindow.setPosition(newX, newY);
    }
  });

  // 监听设置宠物窗口位置事件（保留用于其他功能）
  ipcMain.on('set-pet-window-position', (event, x, y) => {
    if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      try {
        petWindow.setPosition(x, y);
        console.log('设置宠物窗口位置:', x, y);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('设置宠物窗口位置失败:', error);
      }
    }
  });

  // 监听拖拽结束事件，进行边缘吸附
  ipcMain.on('drag-end', (event) => {
    console.log('Drag ended');
    isDragging = false;

    // 恢复正常的鼠标事件处理，允许右键菜单和点击
    if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      petWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents(false);
      // 确保窗口可以接收所有鼠标事件
      petWindow.setMovable(true);
      petWindow.setFocusable(true);
    }

    // 拖动结束后进行吸附判定 - 暂时注释掉
    // performSnapCheck();

    // 延迟确保位置更新完成
    setTimeout(() => {
      console.log('Drag ended, position should be updated');
      // 可以在这里添加拖动结束后的其他逻辑
    }, 50);
  });

  // 监听手动重置状态事件（用于调试）
  ipcMain.on('manual-reset-pet-state', (event) => {
    console.log('手动重置桌宠状态');
    resetPetState();
  });

  // 监听状态查询事件
  ipcMain.on('query-pet-state', (event) => {
    const stateInfo = {
      currentEmotion: currentPetEmotion,
      hasTimer: petStateTimer !== null,
      timeRemaining: petStateTimer ? PET_STATE_DURATION : 0
    };
    console.log('当前桌宠状态:', stateInfo);
    event.reply('pet-state-info', stateInfo);
  });

  // 监听旅行位置更新事件
  ipcMain.on('travel-position-update', async (event, data) => {
    try {
      console.log('Travel position update received:', data);

      // 更新当前位置
      if (data.lng && data.lat) {
        currentTravelStatus.currentLocation = { lng: data.lng, lat: data.lat };
        currentTravelStatus.progress = data.progress || 0;

        // 设置天气服务的当前位置
        weatherService.setCurrentLocation(data.lng, data.lat);

        // 获取当前位置的天气信息
        const weatherInfo = await weatherService.getWeatherByCoordinates(data.lng, data.lat);
        currentTravelStatus.currentWeather = weatherInfo;

        console.log('Weather info updated:', weatherInfo);

        // 如果到达新城市，显示状态更新
        if (weatherInfo.isNewCity) {
          const statusMessage = `已到达 ${weatherInfo.cityInfo.city}！\n当前天气：${weatherInfo.summary}`;
          createPetStatusWindow(statusMessage);

          console.log('Entered new city:', weatherInfo.cityInfo.city);
        }

        // 标记旅行正在进行
        currentTravelStatus.isInProgress = true;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating travel position:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听旅行状态查询事件
  ipcMain.on('query-travel-status', (event) => {
    console.log('Travel status requested:', currentTravelStatus);
    event.reply('travel-status-info', currentTravelStatus);
  });

  // 监听获取当前天气事件
  ipcMain.on('get-current-weather', async (event) => {
    try {
      const weatherInfo = await weatherService.getCurrentWeather();
      console.log('Current weather requested:', weatherInfo);
      event.reply('current-weather-info', weatherInfo);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting current weather:', error);
      event.reply('current-weather-info', weatherService.getDefaultWeather());
    }
  });

  // 监听右键菜单关闭事件

  // 吸附检查函数 - 在拖动结束后执行 - 暂时注释掉

  // 监听右键菜单关闭事件
  ipcMain.on('context-menu-closed', (event) => {
    console.log('Context menu closed by user action');
    contextMenuWindow = null;
  });

  // 处理透明度调节
  ipcMain.on('set-pet-transparency', (event, transparency) => {
    console.log('Setting pet transparency to:', transparency);
    try {
      if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        // 将百分比转换为0-1的范围
        const opacity = transparency / 100;
        petWindow.setOpacity(opacity);
        console.log('Pet window opacity set to:', opacity);
      } else {
        console.log('Pet window not available for transparency setting');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error setting pet transparency:', error);
    }
  });

  ipcMain.on('open-transparency-window', (event) => {

      if (transparencyWindow && !transparencyWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        transparencyWindow.close();
        transparencyWindow = null;
      }

      // 获取右键菜单窗口位置
      let x = 0, y = 0;
      if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        const bounds = contextMenuWindow.getBounds();
        x = bounds.x + bounds.width + 10; // 在右键菜单右侧显示
        y = bounds.y;
      }

      const newTransparencyWindow = new BrowserWindow({
        width: 160,
        height: 120,
        frame: false,
        alwaysOnTop: true,
        transparent: true,
        resizable: false,
        skipTaskbar: true,
        webPreferences: {
          nodeIntegration: true,
          contextIsolation: false,
          enableRemoteModule: true
        },
        movable: false,
        focusable: true,
        x: x,
        y: y
      });

      newTransparencyWindow.loadFile('transparencyWindow.html');

      newTransparencyWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
        console.error('Transparency window crashed');
        transparencyWindow = null;
      });

      newTransparencyWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
        console.error('Transparency window failed to load:', errorDescription);
        transparencyWindow = null;
      });

      newTransparencyWindow.on('closed', () => {
        transparencyWindow = null;
        console.log('Transparency window closed, global variable cleared');
      });

      transparencyWindow = newTransparencyWindow;
      console.log('Transparency window created successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating transparency window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 关闭透明度控制窗口
  ipcMain.on('close-transparency-window', (event) => {
    console.log('Closing transparency control window');
    try {
      if (transparencyWindow && !transparencyWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        transparencyWindow.close();
        transparencyWindow = null;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing transparency window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听透明度窗口关闭事件

    console.log('Transparency window closed by user action');
    transparencyWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听透明度窗口打开事件
  ipcMain.on('transparency-window-opened', (event) => {
    console.log('Transparency window opened');
    // 通知右键菜单透明度窗口状态
    if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      try {
        contextMenuWindow.webContents.send('transparency-window-status', true);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error sending transparency window status to context menu:', error);
      }
    }
  });

  // 监听透明度窗口状态更新
  ipcMain.on('transparency-window-status', (event, isOpen) => {
    console.log('Transparency window status update:', isOpen);
    // 转发状态到右键菜单
    if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      try {
        contextMenuWindow.webContents.send('transparency-window-status', isOpen);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error forwarding transparency window status:', error);
      }
    }
  });

  // 监听打开地图窗口请求
  ipcMain.on('open-map-window', (event) => {
    console.log('Opening map window from context menu');
    try {
      if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        mapWindow.show();
        mapWindow.focus();
      } else {
        // 检查是否有旅行数据
        if (globalTravelData && globalTravelData.origin && globalTravelData.destination) {
          // 有旅行数据，创建地图窗口
          createMapWindow(globalTravelData);
        } else {
          // 没有旅行数据，显示状态提醒
          console.log('No travel data available, showing status reminder');
          const reminderMessage = '还没有设置目的地，请按F2截图触发旅行！';
          createPetStatusWindow(reminderMessage);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error opening map window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听关闭右键菜单事件
  ipcMain.on('close-context-menu', (event) => {
    console.log('Closing context menu from external request');
    if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      contextMenuWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 监听关闭小旅星窗口事件
  ipcMain.on('close-pet-status-window', (event) => {
    console.log('Closing pet status window from external request');
    if (petStatusWindow && !petStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      petStatusWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 设置窗口移动监听器
  // setupWindowMoveListener(); // 暂时注释掉

  return petWindow;
}

// 创建宠物状态弹窗窗口
function createPetStatusWindow(message) {
  console.log('Creating pet status window with message:', message);

  // 关闭已存在的小旅星窗口
  if (petStatusWindow && !petStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing pet status window');
    try {
      petStatusWindow.close();
      petStatusWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing pet status window:', error);
      petStatusWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newPetStatusWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 220,
    height: 120,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true,
    hasShadow: false
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.loadFile('petStatus.html');

  // 智能计算弹窗位置，避免被桌面边框遮挡
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 获取宠物窗口位置和大小
  let petPosition, petSize;

  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 强制刷新位置信息
      petPosition = petWindow.getPosition();
      petSize = petWindow.getSize();

      // 验证位置信息的有效性
      if (petPosition && Array.isArray(petPosition) && petPosition.length === 2 &&
        petSize && Array.isArray(petSize) && petSize.length === 2) {
        console.log('Pet window position:', petPosition, 'size:', petSize);
      } else {
        throw new Error('Invalid position or size data');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error getting pet window position:', error);
      petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
      petSize = [100, 100];
    }
  } else {
    petPosition = [screenWidth - 120, screenHeight - 120];
    petSize = [100, 100];
    console.log('Using default pet position:', petPosition);
  }

  // 气泡窗口的尺寸
  const bubbleWidth = 220;
  const bubbleHeight = 120;
  const bubbleTailHeight = 16; // 尾巴的高度

  // 计算最佳位置
  let bubbleX, bubbleY, bubbleDirection;

  // 计算桌宠中心位置
  const petCenterX = petPosition[0] + (petSize[0] / 2);
  const petCenterY = petPosition[1] + (petSize[1] / 2);

  // 优先尝试上方位置
  if (petPosition[1] >= bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 上方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  } else if (petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleHeight + bubbleTailHeight <= screenHeight) {
    // 下方有足够空间
    bubbleX = petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2);
    bubbleY = petPosition[1] + petSize[1] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleDirection = 'bottom';
  } else if (petPosition[0] >= bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight + 10) {
    // 左侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] - bubbleWidth - bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'left';
  } else if (petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleWidth + bubbleTailHeight <= screenWidth) {
    // 右侧有足够空间
    bubbleX = petPosition[0] + petSize[0] + bubbleTailHeight;
    bubbleY = petCenterY - (bubbleHeight / 2);
    bubbleDirection = 'right';
  } else {
    // 如果所有方向都没有足够空间，强制显示在上方
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - (bubbleWidth / 2)));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, petPosition[1] - bubbleHeight - bubbleTailHeight);
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  // 确保气泡不会超出屏幕边界
  bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, bubbleX));
  bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, bubbleY));

  // 验证计算出的位置是否合理
  const distanceFromPet = Math.sqrt(
    Math.pow(bubbleX + bubbleWidth / 2 - petCenterX, 2) +
    Math.pow(bubbleY + bubbleHeight / 2 - petCenterY, 2)
  );

  // 如果气泡距离桌宠太远（超过200像素），使用默认位置
  if (distanceFromPet > 200) {
    console.warn(`Bubble too far from pet (${distanceFromPet}px), using default position`);
    bubbleX = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenWidth - bubbleWidth - 10, petCenterX - bubbleWidth / 2));
    bubbleY = Math.max(10, Math.min(screenHeight - bubbleHeight - 10, petCenterY - bubbleHeight / 2));
    bubbleDirection = 'top';
  }

  console.log(`Positioning bubble at (${bubbleX}, ${bubbleY}) with direction: ${bubbleDirection}`);
  console.log(`Pet center: (${petCenterX}, ${petCenterY}), Pet position: (${petPosition[0]}, ${petPosition[1]}), Pet size: (${petSize[0]}, ${petSize[1]})`);
  console.log(`Screen size: (${screenWidth}, ${screenHeight}), Bubble size: (${bubbleWidth}, ${bubbleHeight})`);
  console.log(`Distance from pet: ${distanceFromPet}px`);

  newPetStatusWindow.setPosition(Math.round(bubbleX), Math.round(bubbleY));

  // 通过IPC传递消息和气泡方向
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    try {
      console.log('Sending message and direction to status window:', message, bubbleDirection);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('update-status-message', message);
      newPetStatusWindow.webContents.send('set-bubble-direction', bubbleDirection);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error sending message to status window:', error);
    }
  });

  // 监听窗口错误
  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Status window crashed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  newPetStatusWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Status window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件
  newPetStatusWindow.on('closed', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window closed');
    petStatusWindow = null;
  });

  // 监听窗口失去焦点事件（点击外部关闭）
  newPetStatusWindow.on('blur', () => {
    console.log('Pet status window lost focus, closing');
    if (newPetStatusWindow && !newPetStatusWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      newPetStatusWindow.close();
    }
  });

  // 保存到全局变量
  petStatusWindow = newPetStatusWindow;

  return newPetStatusWindow;
}

// 创建右键菜单窗口
function createContextMenuWindow(x, y, petPosition = [0, 0]) {
  // 关闭已存在的右键菜单
  if (contextMenuWindow && !contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Closing existing context menu window');
    try {
      contextMenuWindow.close();
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error closing existing context menu:', error);
      contextMenuWindow = null;
    }
  }

  const newContextMenuWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 180,
    height: 180,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: true,
    resizable: false,
    skipTaskbar: true,
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false,
      enableRemoteModule: true
    },
    movable: false,
    focusable: true
  });

  newContextMenuWindow.loadFile('contextMenu.html');

  // 智能定位：避免被桌面边框遮挡，并根据桌宠位置优化显示方向
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width: screenWidth, height: screenHeight } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  // 菜单尺寸
  const menuWidth = 180;
  const menuHeight = 180;

  // 计算最佳位置
  let finalX = x;
  let finalY = y;

  // 水平方向调整
  if (x + menuWidth > screenWidth) {
    finalX = screenWidth - menuWidth - 10;
  }
  if (finalX < 10) {
    finalX = 10;
  }

  // 垂直方向调整 - 优先显示在桌宠上方，如果空间不够则显示在下方
  const [petX, petY] = petPosition;
  const spaceAbove = y;
  const spaceBelow = screenHeight - y - menuHeight;

  if (spaceAbove >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 上方空间足够，显示在桌宠上方
    finalY = y - menuHeight - 10;
  } else if (spaceBelow >= menuHeight + 20) {
    // 下方空间足够，显示在桌宠下方
    finalY = y + 20;
  } else {
    // 上下空间都不够，调整到屏幕边界内
    if (y + menuHeight > screenHeight) {
      finalY = screenHeight - menuHeight - 10;
    }
    if (finalY < 10) {
      finalY = 10;
    }
  }

  console.log(`Context menu positioning: original(${x}, ${y}), pet(${petX}, ${petY}) -> final(${finalX}, ${finalY})`);
  newContextMenuWindow.setPosition(finalX, finalY);

  // 错误处理
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('crashed', () => {
    console.error('Context menu window crashed');
  });
  newContextMenuWindow.webContents.on('did-fail-load', (event, errorCode, errorDescription) => {
    console.error('Context menu window failed to load:', errorCode, errorDescription);
  });

  // 监听窗口关闭事件，清理全局变量
  newContextMenuWindow.on('closed', () => {
    contextMenuWindow = null;
    console.log('Context menu window closed, global variable cleared');
  });

  // 监听窗口即将关闭事件
  newContextMenuWindow.on('close', () => {
    console.log('Context menu window closing...');
  });

  // 自动关闭功能
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      if (newContextMenuWindow && !newContextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        console.log('Auto-closing context menu window');
        newContextMenuWindow.close();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error auto-closing context menu window:', error);
    }
  }, 5000); // 5秒后自动关闭

  // 更新全局变量
  contextMenuWindow = newContextMenuWindow;
  return newContextMenuWindow;
}

// 设置全局点击处理器来关闭右键菜单
function setupGlobalClickHandler() {
  if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    return;
  }

  console.log('Setting up global click handler for context menu');

  // 简化版本：直接使用定时器检查右键菜单状态
  const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!contextMenuWindow || contextMenuWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      clearInterval(checkInterval);
      console.log('Context menu closed, clearing click handler');
    }
  }, 100);

  // 5秒后自动清理
  setTimeout(() => {
    clearInterval(checkInterval);
  }, 5000);
}

// 创建地图窗口
function createMapWindow(travelData = { origin: '武汉光谷', destination: '北京天安门' }) {
  console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);

  // 检查是否已存在地图窗口
  if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    console.log('Map window already exists, showing and focusing');
    mapWindow.show();
    mapWindow.focus();
    return mapWindow;
  }

  // 清理旅行数据中的乱码字符
  const cleanTravelData = {
    origin: cleanText(travelData.origin) || '武汉光谷',
    destination: cleanText(travelData.destination) || '北京天安门',
    userLocation: travelData.userLocation || null
  };

  // 保存到全局变量
  globalTravelData = cleanTravelData;

  console.log('Cleaned travel data:', cleanTravelData);

  mapWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 800,
    height: 600,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: false, // 与主页面保持一致
    transparent: false,
    resizable: true, // 允许调整大小
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    },
    movable: true, // 允许窗口移动
    minimizable: true, // 允许最小化
    maximizable: true, // 允许最大化
    show: false // 初始不显示，等待加载完成后显示
  });

  mapWindow.loadFile('map.html');

  // 设置地图窗口位置到屏幕中央
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  mapWindow.setPosition(
    Math.round((width - 800) / 2),
    Math.round((height - 600) / 2)
  );

  // 通过IPC将高德地图API Key和旅行信息传递给地图窗口
  mapWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    // 传递API Key
    console.log('Passing API Key to map window');
    mapWindow.webContents.executeJavaScript(`
      window.AMAP_KEY = '${process.env.AMAP_KEY || ''}';
      console.log('API Key set in map window:', window.AMAP_KEY ? window.AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'Not set');
    `);

    // 发送旅行信息
    console.log('Sending travel info to map window');
    setTimeout(() => {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }, 1000);

    // 显示窗口
    mapWindow.show();
  });

  // 监听地图窗口关闭事件，改为隐藏而不是销毁
  mapWindow.on('close', (event) => {
    if (!app.isQuitting) {
      event.preventDefault();
      mapWindow.hide();
      console.log('Map window hidden instead of closed');
    } else {
      // 应用退出时清理全局变量
      globalTravelData = null;
      console.log('App quitting, clearing global travel data');
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口请求旅行信息
  ipcMain.on('request-travel-info', () => {
    console.log('Map window requesting travel info');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.webContents.send('travel-info', cleanTravelData);
    }
  });

  // 监听地图窗口隐藏请求
  ipcMain.on('hide-map-window', () => {
    console.log('Hiding map window');
    if (mapWindow && !mapWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      mapWindow.hide();
    }
  });

  return mapWindow;
}

// 清理文本中的乱码字符
function cleanText(text) {
  if (!text) return text;

  // 移除常见的乱码字符
  return text.replace(/[^\x20-\x7E\u4e00-\u9fa5]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\u4e00-\u9fa5\s\-_]/g, '')
    .trim();
}

// 创建通知气泡窗口
function createBubbleWindow(message) {
  bubbleWindow = new BrowserWindow({
    width: 300,
    height: 100,
    frame: false,
    alwaysOnTop: true,
    transparent: false, // 禁用透明度以提高兼容性
    webPreferences: {
      nodeIntegration: true,
      contextIsolation: false
    }
  });

  bubbleWindow.loadFile('bubble.html');

  // 通过IPC将AI生成的消息传递给气泡窗口
  bubbleWindow.webContents.once('dom-ready', () => {
    bubbleWindow.webContents.send('update-bubble-message', message);
  });

  return bubbleWindow;
}

// 截取屏幕截图
async function captureScreenshot() {
  try {
    console.log('📸 Capturing screenshot...');
    const sources = await desktopCapturer.getSources({
      types: ['screen'],
      thumbnailSize: { width: 800, height: 600 }
    });

    if (sources && sources.length > 0) {
      // 获取第一张屏幕截图
      const source = sources[0];
      const thumbnail = source.thumbnail;

      // 将截图转换为base64编码
      const base64Data = thumbnail.toDataURL().replace(/^data:image\/(png|jpeg);base64,/, '');
      console.log('📸 Screenshot captured, size:', base64Data.length, 'characters');

      // 使用AI分析截图内容
      console.log('🤖 Analyzing screenshot with AI...');
      const aiResponse = await analyzeScreenshot(base64Data);
      console.log('✅ AI analysis completed:', aiResponse);
      return aiResponse;
    } else {
      console.log('❌ No screen sources found');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Screenshot capture failed:', error);
  }

  // 如果出错，返回默认响应
  console.log('🔄 Returning fallback response');
  return {
    message: "替你去看北京天安门？",
    shouldTravel: true,
    confidence: 0.5
  };
}

// 注册全局快捷键监听截图
function registerScreenshotListener() {
  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F2');

    // 更改截图快捷键为F2
    const ret = globalShortcut.register('F2', async () => {
      console.log('Screenshot taken!');

      // 捕获并分析截图
      const aiResponse = await captureScreenshot();
      console.log('AI analysis result:', aiResponse);

      // 使用小旅星窗口显示AI回复
      createPetStatusWindow(aiResponse.message);

      // 如果AI判断需要触发旅行，则显示气泡提示
      if (aiResponse.shouldTravel) {
        // 显示AI生成的气泡提示
        setTimeout(() => {
          showScreenshotBubble(aiResponse.message);
        }, 1200);
      }

      // 切换宠物表情并设置状态复原
      if (aiResponse.emotion && petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
        try {
          petWindow.webContents.send('change-emotion', aiResponse.emotion);
          console.log('Sent emotion change to pet:', aiResponse.emotion);

          // 设置状态并启动复原计时器
          setPetState(aiResponse.emotion);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to send emotion change:', error);
        }
      }
    });

    if (!ret) {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Screenshot listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Screenshot listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F3');

    // 注册测试用快捷键
    const ret2 = globalShortcut.register('F3', async () => {
      console.log('Manual water reminder triggered!');
      createWaterReminderWindow();
    });

    if (!ret2) {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Water reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Water reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F4');

    // 注册另一个测试用快捷键
    const ret3 = globalShortcut.register('F4', async () => {
      console.log('Manual fun reminder triggered!');
      // 生成AI趣味提醒
      const funMessage = await generateFunReminder();
      createPetStatusWindow(funMessage);
    });

    if (!ret3) {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Fun reminder listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Fun reminder listener registration error:', error);
  }

  try {
    // 先注销可能已注册的快捷键
    globalShortcut.unregister('F6');

    // 注册手动重置状态快捷键
    const ret4 = globalShortcut.register('F6', () => {
      console.log('Manual reset pet state triggered!');
      resetPetState();
    });

    if (!ret4) {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registration failed');
    } else {
      console.log('Reset pet state listener registered successfully');
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('Reset pet state listener registration error:', error);
  }
}

// 显示截图响应气泡（放置在右上角）
function showScreenshotBubble(message) {
  const bubbleWindow = createBubbleWindow(message);

  // 设置气泡窗口位置到屏幕右上角（避免遮挡通知区域）
  const { screen } = require('electron');
  const primaryDisplay = screen.getPrimaryDisplay();
  const { width, height } = primaryDisplay.workAreaSize;

  bubbleWindow.setPosition(
    width - 310,
    150 // 距离顶部150像素，避免遮挡Windows通知
  );

  // 10秒后自动关闭
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (bubbleWindow && !bubbleWindow.isDestroyed()) {
      bubbleWindow.close();
    }
  }, 10000);
}

// IPC事件处理：开始旅程
ipcMain.on('start-journey', async (event, data) => {
  console.log('Starting journey to:', data.destination);

  // 提取目的地信息（从AI回复中提取地点名）
  let destination = '北京天安门';
  if (data.destination) {
    // 尝试从"替你去看[地点]？"格式中提取地点
    const match = data.destination.match(/替你去看(.+)[？\?]/);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      destination = match[1];
    } else {
      destination = data.destination;
    }
  }

  try {
    // 获取用户当前位置作为起点
    console.log('Getting user current location...');
    const userLocation = await amapService.getUserLocationDetails();
    console.log('User location info:', userLocation);

    // 创建地图窗口并传递旅行数据
    const travelData = {
      origin: `${userLocation.city}`,
      destination: destination,
      userLocation: userLocation
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    // 初始化旅行状态
    currentTravelStatus = {
      isInProgress: true,
      currentLocation: userLocation.coordinates ? { lng: userLocation.coordinates[0], lat: userLocation.coordinates[1] } : null,
      currentWeather: null,
      lastCity: userLocation.city,
      totalDistance: 0,
      traveledDistance: 0,
      progress: 0
    };

    // 获取起点天气信息
    if (currentTravelStatus.currentLocation) {
      try {
        weatherService.setCurrentLocation(currentTravelStatus.currentLocation.lng, currentTravelStatus.currentLocation.lat);
        const initialWeather = await weatherService.getWeatherByCoordinates(
          currentTravelStatus.currentLocation.lng, 
          currentTravelStatus.currentLocation.lat
        );
        currentTravelStatus.currentWeather = initialWeather;
        console.log('Initial weather info:', initialWeather);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error getting initial weather:', error);
      }
    }

    console.log('Creating map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get user location, using default location:', error);

    // 如果获取用户位置失败，使用默认位置
    const travelData = {
      origin: '武汉光谷',
      destination: destination
    };

    // 保存到全局变量
    globalTravelData = travelData;

    console.log('Using default location to create map window, travel data:', travelData);
    createMapWindow(travelData);
  }

  // 可以在这里添加更多旅程启动逻辑
});

});

// 设置桌宠状态并启动复原计时器
function setPetState(emotion) {
  // 清除之前的计时器
  if (petStateTimer) {
    clearTimeout(petStateTimer);
  }

  currentPetEmotion = emotion;
  console.log('设置桌宠状态:', emotion);

  // 设置复原计时器
  petStateTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    resetPetState();
  }, PET_STATE_DURATION);
}

// 重置桌宠状态为初始状态
function resetPetState() {
  if (petWindow && !petWindow.isDestroyed()) {
    try {
      // 发送重置状态信号给渲染进程
      petWindow.webContents.send('reset-emotion');
      console.log('重置桌宠状态为初始状态');

      // 清除状态记录
      currentPetEmotion = null;
      if (petStateTimer) {
        clearTimeout(petStateTimer);
        petStateTimer = null;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('重置桌宠状态失败:', error);
    }
  }
}
```

```html
    <script>
        // 屏蔽系统右键菜单
        document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;
        });

        // 屏蔽文本选择
        document.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        });

        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');
        const progress = document.getElementById('progress');
        const timeIcon = document.getElementById('time-icon');
        const dragHandle = document.getElementById('dragHandle');
        const routeInfo = document.getElementById('route-info');
        const weatherEl = document.getElementById('weather');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
        const amapContainer = document.getElementById('amap-container');
        const debugInfo = document.getElementById('debug-info');
        const currentLocation = document.getElementById('current-location');
        const destLocation = document.getElementById('dest-location');
        const zoomIn = document.getElementById('zoom-in');
        const zoomOut = document.getElementById('zoom-out');
        const resetView = document.getElementById('reset-view');
        const debugState = document.getElementById('debug-state');
        const testMarker = document.getElementById('test-marker');


        // 全局变量存储地图实例和位置信息
        let mapInstance = null;
        let originCoords = null;
        let destCoords = null;
        let travelData = null;

        // 旅行动画相关变量
        let travelerMarker = null;
        let routePath = [];
        let currentPathIndex = 0;
        let travelAnimation = null;
        let isTraveling = false;
        let travelSpeed = 200; // 移动间隔（毫秒）- 调整为更慢的速度便于观察
        let totalDistance = 0;
        let traveledDistance = 0;

        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            try {
                require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('hide-map-window');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error hiding map window:', error);
                // 如果IPC失败，则直接关闭窗口
                window.close();
            }
        });

        // 缩放控件事件监听
        zoomIn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                const currentZoom = mapInstance.getZoom();
                mapInstance.setZoom(currentZoom + 1);
            }
        });

        zoomOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                const currentZoom = mapInstance.getZoom();
                mapInstance.setZoom(currentZoom - 1);
            }
        });

        resetView.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance && window.originCoords && window.destCoords) {
                // 重置到显示起点和终点的视野
                const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                    new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.min(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1])),
                    new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.max(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1]))
                );
                mapInstance.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
            }
        });

        // 调试按钮事件监听
        debugState.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.debugTravelState();
            debugInfo.textContent = '调试信息已输出到控制台';
        });

        // 测试标记按钮事件监听
        testMarker.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.testTravelerMarker();
            debugInfo.textContent = '测试标记已创建，3秒后自动移除';
        });



        // 根据时间切换日/夜图标
        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        if (hour >= 18 || hour < 6) {
            timeIcon.textContent = '🌙';
        }

        // 监听窗口大小变化，调整地图大小
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                // 延迟执行以确保DOM更新完成
                setTimeout(() => {
                    mapInstance.resize();

                    // 如果有起点和终点坐标，重新调整视野
                    if (window.originCoords && window.destCoords) {
                        const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                            new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.min(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1])),
                            new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.max(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1]))
                        );
                        mapInstance.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                    }
                }, 100);
            }
        });

        // 从主进程获取旅行信息
        const ipcRenderer = require('electron').ipcRenderer;
        let AMAP_KEY = '';

        // 监听主进程发送的旅行信息
        ipcRenderer.on('travel-info', async (event, data) => {
            console.log('Received travel info:', data);
            debugInfo.textContent = `接收到旅行信息: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;

            // 更新界面信息
            if (data.origin && data.destination) {
                routeInfo.textContent = `${data.origin} → ${data.destination}`;
                currentLocation.textContent = data.origin;
                destLocation.textContent = data.destination;
            }

            // 保存旅行数据
            travelData = data;

            // 初始化高德地图
            await initMap(data);
        });

        // 初始化高德地图
        async function initMap(travelData) {
            debugInfo.textContent = '检查API Key配置...';
            console.log(travelData);

            // 从主进程获取API Key
            AMAP_KEY = window.AMAP_KEY || '';

            // 检查API Key是否存在
            if (!AMAP_KEY || AMAP_KEY === 'undefined') {
                console.error('AMap API Key not configured');
                debugInfo.textContent = '错误: API Key未配置，请在.env文件中设置AMAP_KEY';
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>API Key未配置</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">请在.env文件中设置AMAP_KEY</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            debugInfo.textContent = `API Key存在，开始地理编码: ${AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10)}...`;

            try {
                // 获取始发地和目的地的经纬度
                let originCoords;

                // 如果有用户位置信息，优先使用
                if (travelData.userLocation && travelData.userLocation.coordinates) {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '使用用户位置作为起点...';
                    originCoords = travelData.userLocation.coordinates;
                    console.log('Using user location as origin:', originCoords);
                } else {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '获取始发地坐标...';
                    originCoords = await geocodeAddress(travelData.origin || '武汉光谷');
                    debugInfo.textContent = `始发地坐标获取成功: ${originCoords}`;
                    console.log('Origin coordinates:', originCoords);
                }

                debugInfo.textContent = '获取目的地坐标...';
                const destCoords = await geocodeAddress(travelData.destination || '北京天安门');
                debugInfo.textContent = `目的地坐标获取成功: ${destCoords}`;
                console.log('Destination coordinates:', destCoords);

                // 保存坐标到全局变量
                window.originCoords = originCoords;
                window.destCoords = destCoords;

                // 加载高德地图JS API
                debugInfo.textContent = '加载高德地图JS API...';
                await loadAMapAPI();

                // 创建地图并绘制路线
                debugInfo.textContent = '创建地图实例...';
                createMap(originCoords, destCoords, travelData);
            } catch (error) {
                debugInfo.textContent = `地图初始化错误: ${error.message}`;
                console.error('Map initialization error:', error);
                // 记录错误到日志文件
                logErrorToFile(`地图初始化错误: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>地图初始化失败</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">错误信息: ${error.message}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // 加载高德地图JS API
        function loadAMapAPI() {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = `https://webapi.amap.com/maps?v=1.4.15&key=${AMAP_KEY}`;

                script.onload = function () {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '高德地图API加载成功';
                    console.log('AMap API loaded successfully');
                    resolve();
                };

                script.onerror = function (error) {
                    debugInfo.textContent = `高德地图API加载失败: ${error.message}`;
                    console.error('AMap API loading failed:', error);
                    // 记录错误到日志文件
                    logErrorToFile(`高德地图API加载失败: ${error.message}`);
                    reject(new Error('高德地图API加载失败'));
                };

                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        // 创建地图并绘制路线
        function createMap(originCoords, destCoords, travelData) {
            try {
                // 检查AMap是否已定义
                if (typeof AMap === 'undefined') {
                    const errorMsg = 'AMap未定义，请检查API加载是否成功';
                    debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                    console.error(errorMsg);
                    // 记录错误到日志文件
                    logErrorToFile(errorMsg);
                    throw new Error(errorMsg);
                }

                // 确保坐标格式正确
                const originLngLat = Array.isArray(originCoords)
                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                    : originCoords;

                // 创建地图实例
                const map = new AMap.Map('amap-container', {
                    zoom: 12, // 更高的缩放级别，显示更详细的局部区域
                    center: originLngLat,
                    mapStyle: 'amap://styles/normal',
                    showIndoorMap: false, // 不显示室内地图
                    dragEnable: true, // 允许拖拽
                    zoomEnable: true, // 允许缩放
                    doubleClickZoom: true, // 允许双击缩放
                    scrollWheel: true // 允许滚轮缩放
                });

                // 保存地图实例到全局变量
                mapInstance = map;

                // 添加地图事件监听
                map.on('zoomend', () => {
                    const zoom = map.getZoom();
                    debugInfo.textContent = `地图缩放级别: ${zoom}`;
                });

                map.on('moveend', () => {
                    const center = map.getCenter();
                    debugInfo.textContent = `地图中心: ${center.lng.toFixed(4)}, ${center.lat.toFixed(4)}`;
                });

                // 添加点击事件，允许用户点击地图重新定位
                map.on('click', (e) => {
                    const lnglat = e.lnglat;
                    debugInfo.textContent = `点击位置: ${lnglat.lng.toFixed(4)}, ${lnglat.lat.toFixed(4)}`;

                    // 可以在这里添加反向地理编码，获取点击位置的地址信息
                    // 暂时只显示坐标信息
                });

                // 地图加载完成后调整大小
                map.on('complete', () => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        map.resize();
                    }, 100);
                });

                debugInfo.textContent = '地图实例创建成功';
                console.log('Map instance created successfully');

                // 使用高德地图WebService API获取驾车路线数据
                debugInfo.textContent = '获取驾车路线数据...';
                console.log('Starting route request with:', {
                    originCoords: originCoords,
                    destCoords: destCoords,
                    AMAP_KEY: AMAP_KEY ? 'Configured' : 'Not configured'
                });

                getDrivingRoute(originCoords, destCoords)
                    .then(routeData => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = '驾车路线数据获取成功';
                        console.log('Driving route data:', routeData);

                        // 清除加载提示
                        amapContainer.querySelector('.loading')?.remove();

                        if (routeData.status === '1' && routeData.route && routeData.route.paths && routeData.route.paths.length > 0) {
                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线规划成功，绘制路线...';
                            console.log('Route planning successful');

                            try {
                                // 解析路线数据
                                const paths = routeData.route.paths[0];
                                if (paths && paths.steps && paths.steps.length > 0) {
                                    const steps = paths.steps;

                                    // 构建路线坐标点数组
                                    let routePath = [];
                                    steps.forEach(step => {
                                        const polyline = step.polyline;
                                        if (polyline) {
                                            const points = polyline.split(';').map(point => {
                                                const [lng, lat] = point.split(',').map(Number);
                                                return new AMap.LngLat(lng, lat);
                                            });
                                            routePath = routePath.concat(points);
                                        }
                                    });

                                    // 保存路线到全局变量
                                    window.routePath = routePath;
                                    window.currentPathIndex = 0;

                                    console.log('Route path saved to window.routePath:', {
                                        length: routePath.length,
                                        firstPoint: routePath[0],
                                        lastPoint: routePath[routePath.length - 1]
                                    });

                                    // 如果有路线点，创建路线覆盖物
                                    if (routePath.length > 0) {
                                        const polyline = new AMap.Polyline({
                                            path: routePath,
                                            strokeColor: "#3366FF",
                                            strokeWeight: 6,
                                            strokeOpacity: 0.8
                                        });

                                        map.add(polyline);
                                        debugInfo.textContent = `路线绘制成功，共${routePath.length}个坐标点`;

                                        // 创建旅行者标记
                                        createTravelerMarker();
                                    } else {
                                        debugInfo.textContent = '路线点数据为空，跳过路线绘制';
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    debugInfo.textContent = '路线步骤数据为空，跳过路线绘制';
                                }
                            } catch (error) {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `路线数据处理错误: ${error.message}`;
                                console.error('Route data processing error:', error);
                            }

                            // 调整地图视野以适应路线，但优先显示起点附近
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );

                            // 如果起点和终点距离较远，优先显示起点附近
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(
                                Math.pow(originCoords[0] - destCoords[0], 2) +
                                Math.pow(originCoords[1] - destCoords[1], 2)
                            );

                            if (distance > 0.1) { // 如果距离较远（约10公里以上）
                                // 显示起点附近的详细视图
                                map.setCenter(new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]));
                                map.setZoom(14); // 更高的缩放级别显示局部详情

                                // 添加一个小的延迟，然后显示完整路线预览
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                                }, 2000);
                            } else {
                                // 距离较近时显示完整路线
                                map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                            }

                            // 添加起点和终点标记
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            // 添加标记点击事件
                            startMarker.on('click', () => {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `起点: ${travelData.origin}`;
                            });

                            endMarker.on('click', () => {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `终点: ${travelData.destination}`;
                                // 点击终点时，将地图中心移动到终点
                                map.setCenter(endMarker.getPosition());
                                map.setZoom(16);
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '地图绘制完成，准备开始旅行动画';
                            console.log('Map drawing completed, starting travel animation');

                            // 延迟2秒后自动开始旅行动画
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                startTravelAnimation();
                            }, 2000);
                        } else {
                            const errorMsg = `路线规划失败: ${JSON.stringify(routeData)}`;
                            debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                            console.log('Failed to get route:', routeData);
                            // 记录错误到日志文件
                            logErrorToFile(errorMsg);

                            // 即使路线规划失败，也显示起点和终点标记
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            // 调整视野以显示两个标记
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );
                            map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线规划失败，但已显示起点和终点标记';

                            // 添加一条直线连接起点和终点
                            try {
                                const directPath = [
                                    new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]),
                                    new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                ];

                                const directLine = new AMap.Polyline({
                                    path: directPath,
                                    strokeColor: "#FF6B6B",
                                    strokeWeight: 3,
                                    strokeOpacity: 0.6,
                                    strokeStyle: "dashed"
                                });

                                map.add(directLine);

                                // 创建简化的路线用于动画（在起点和终点之间插值）
                                const simplifiedPath = createSimplifiedPath(originCoords, destCoords, 50);
                                window.routePath = simplifiedPath;
                                window.currentPathIndex = 0;

                                console.log('Simplified path saved to window.routePath:', {
                                    length: simplifiedPath.length,
                                    firstPoint: simplifiedPath[0],
                                    lastPoint: simplifiedPath[simplifiedPath.length - 1]
                                });

                                // 创建旅行者标记
                                createTravelerMarker();

                                debugInfo.textContent = '已显示直线连接起点和终点，准备开始简化旅行动画';

                                // 延迟2秒后自动开始简化旅行动画
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    startTravelAnimation();
                                }, 2000);
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Failed to create direct line:', error);
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `获取路线数据失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Failed to get route data:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`获取路线数据失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);

                        // 即使路线加载失败，也显示起点和终点标记
                        try {
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            // 添加一条直线连接起点和终点
                            const directPath = [
                                new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]),
                                new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                            ];

                            const directLine = new AMap.Polyline({
                                path: directPath,
                                strokeColor: "#FF6B6B",
                                strokeWeight: 3,
                                strokeOpacity: 0.6,
                                strokeStyle: "dashed"
                            });

                            map.add(directLine);

                            // 调整视野以显示两个标记
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );
                            map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线加载失败，但已显示起点、终点和连接线';
                        } catch (markerError) {
                            console.error('Failed to create markers:', markerError);
                            debugInfo.textContent = '无法创建地图标记';
                        }
                    });
            } catch (error) {
                const errorMsg = `创建地图失败: ${error.message}`;
                debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                console.error('Failed to create map:', error);
                // 记录错误到日志文件
                logErrorToFile(`创建地图失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>创建地图失败</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">错误信息: ${error.message}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // 获取驾车路线数据 - 使用WebService API
        function getDrivingRoute(originCoords, destCoords) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                // 确保坐标格式正确
                const origin = Array.isArray(originCoords) ? originCoords.join(',') : originCoords;
                const destination = Array.isArray(destCoords) ? destCoords.join(',') : destCoords;

                // 验证坐标格式
                if (!origin || !destination) {
                    const error = new Error('坐标格式错误');
                    debugInfo.textContent = `坐标格式错误: origin=${origin}, destination=${destination}`;
                    reject(error);
                    return;
                }

                const url = `https://restapi.amap.com/v3/direction/driving?origin=${origin}&destination=${destination}&key=${AMAP_KEY}`;

                debugInfo.textContent = `请求驾车路线: ${url.substring(0, 50)}...`;
                console.log('Requesting driving route:', url);
                console.log('Origin coords:', originCoords);
                console.log('Destination coords:', destCoords);

                fetch(url)
                    .then(response => {
                        if (!response.ok) {
                            throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
                        }
                        return response.json();
                    })
                    .then(data => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `驾车路线响应状态: ${data.status}, 信息: ${data.info}`;
                        console.log('Driving route response:', data);

                        // 检查API响应状态
                        if (data.status === '1') {
                            resolve(data);
                        } else {
                            const error = new Error(`API错误: ${data.info || '未知错误'}`);
                            debugInfo.textContent = `API错误: ${data.info}`;
                            reject(error);
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `请求驾车路线失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Failed to request driving route:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`请求驾车路线失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                        reject(error);
                    });
            });
        }

        // 地理编码（地址转坐标）- 使用HTTP API
        function geocodeAddress(address) {
            debugInfo.textContent = `开始地理编码: ${address}`;
            console.log('Starting geocoding:', address);

            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                // 构造请求URL
                const url = `https://restapi.amap.com/v3/geocode/geo?key=${AMAP_KEY}&address=${encodeURIComponent(address)}`;
                debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码请求URL: ${url.substring(0, 50)}...`;
                console.log('Geocoding request URL:', url);

                // 发起HTTP请求
                fetch(url)
                    .then(response => response.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码响应: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;
                        console.log('Geocoding response:', data);

                        if (data.status === '1' && data.geocodes && data.geocodes.length > 0) {
                            // 解析坐标
                            const location = data.geocodes[0].location;
                            const [lng, lat] = location.split(',').map(Number);
                            const coords = [lng, lat];
                            debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码成功: ${coords}`;
                            console.log('Geocoding successful:', coords);
                            resolve(coords);
                        } else {
                            debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码失败，使用默认坐标`;
                            console.log('Geocoding failed, using default coordinates');
                            // 如果地理编码失败，使用默认坐标
                            if (address.includes('武汉')) {
                                resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]); // 武汉光谷
                            } else if (address.includes('北京')) {
                                resolve([116.397455, 39.909187]); // 北京天安门
                            } else {
                                // 默认使用武汉光谷坐标
                                resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]);
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码请求失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Geocoding request failed:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`地理编码请求失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                        // 使用默认坐标
                        if (address.includes('武汉')) {
                            resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]); // 武汉光谷
                        } else if (address.includes('北京')) {
                            resolve([116.397455, 39.909187]); // 北京天安门
                        } else {
                            // 默认使用武汉光谷坐标
                            resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]);
                        }
                    });
            });
        }

        // 记录错误到日志文件
        function logErrorToFile(errorMessage) {
            try {
                const fs = require('fs');
                const path = require('path');
                const logMessage = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${errorMessage}\n`;
                const logPath = path.join(__dirname, 'logs.txt');
                fs.appendFileSync(logPath, logMessage);
            } catch (logError) {
                console.error('Failed to write to log file:', logError);
            }
        }

        // 页面加载完成后请求旅行信息
        window.onload = function () {
            debugInfo.textContent = '页面加载完成，请求旅行信息...';
            // 请求主进程发送旅行信息
            ipcRenderer.send('request-travel-info');
        };

        // 全局调试函数
        window.debugTravelState = function () {
            console.log('=== Travel State Debug ===');
            console.log('window.routePath:', window.routePath);
            console.log('window.currentPathIndex:', window.currentPathIndex);
            console.log('mapInstance:', !!mapInstance);
            console.log('travelerMarker:', !!travelerMarker);
            console.log('isTraveling:', isTraveling);
            console.log('travelAnimation:', !!travelAnimation);
            console.log('travelSpeed:', travelSpeed);

            if (window.routePath) {
                console.log('Route path length:', window.routePath.length);
                console.log('First point:', window.routePath[0]);
                console.log('Last point:', window.routePath[window.routePath.length - 1]);
            }

            if (travelerMarker) {
                console.log('Traveler marker position:', travelerMarker.getPosition());
                console.log('Traveler marker visible:', travelerMarker.getVisible());
            }

            if (mapInstance) {
                const markers = mapInstance.getAllOverlays('marker');
```
