        </div>



        <!-- 位置信息 -->
        <div class="location-info" id="location-info">
            <div><span class="current">出发地</span>: <span id="current-location">加载中...</span></div>
            <div><span class="current">目的地</span>: <span id="dest-location">加载中...</span></div>
        </div>

        <!-- 高德地图容器 -->
        <div id="amap-container">
            <div class="loading">
                <div>地图加载中...</div>
                <div class="debug-info" id="debug-info"></div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="destination">🏯</div>

        <div class="progress-bar">
            <div class="progress" id="progress"></div>
        </div>

        <div class="status-text" id="status-text">
            预计11小时后抵达，每小时寄回一张照片
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        // 屏蔽系统右键菜单
        document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;
        });

        // 屏蔽文本选择
        document.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        });

        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');
        const progress = document.getElementById('progress');
        const timeIcon = document.getElementById('time-icon');
        const dragHandle = document.getElementById('dragHandle');
        const routeInfo = document.getElementById('route-info');
        const weatherEl = document.getElementById('weather');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
        const amapContainer = document.getElementById('amap-container');
        const debugInfo = document.getElementById('debug-info');
        const currentLocation = document.getElementById('current-location');
        const destLocation = document.getElementById('dest-location');
        const zoomIn = document.getElementById('zoom-in');
        const zoomOut = document.getElementById('zoom-out');
        const resetView = document.getElementById('reset-view');
        const debugState = document.getElementById('debug-state');
        const testMarker = document.getElementById('test-marker');


        // 全局变量存储地图实例和位置信息
        let mapInstance = null;
        let originCoords = null;
        let destCoords = null;
        let travelData = null;

        // 旅行动画相关变量
        let travelerMarker = null;
        let routePath = [];
        let currentPathIndex = 0;
        let travelAnimation = null;
        let isTraveling = false;
        let travelSpeed = 200; // 移动间隔（毫秒）- 调整为更慢的速度便于观察
        let totalDistance = 0;
        let traveledDistance = 0;

        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            try {
                require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('hide-map-window');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error hiding map window:', error);
                // 如果IPC失败，则直接关闭窗口
                window.close();
            }
        });

        // 缩放控件事件监听
        zoomIn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                const currentZoom = mapInstance.getZoom();
                mapInstance.setZoom(currentZoom + 1);
            }
        });

        zoomOut.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                const currentZoom = mapInstance.getZoom();
                mapInstance.setZoom(currentZoom - 1);
            }
        });

        resetView.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (mapInstance && window.originCoords && window.destCoords) {
                // 重置到显示起点和终点的视野
                const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                    new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.min(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1])),
                    new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.max(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1]))
                );
                mapInstance.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
            }
        });

        // 调试按钮事件监听
        debugState.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.debugTravelState();
            debugInfo.textContent = '调试信息已输出到控制台';
        });

        // 测试标记按钮事件监听
        testMarker.addEventListener('click', () => {
            window.testTravelerMarker();
            debugInfo.textContent = '测试标记已创建，3秒后自动移除';
        });



        // 根据时间切换日/夜图标
        const hour = new Date().getHours();
        if (hour >= 18 || hour < 6) {
            timeIcon.textContent = '🌙';
        }

        // 监听窗口大小变化，调整地图大小
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            if (mapInstance) {
                // 延迟执行以确保DOM更新完成
                setTimeout(() => {
                    mapInstance.resize();

                    // 如果有起点和终点坐标，重新调整视野
                    if (window.originCoords && window.destCoords) {
                        const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                            new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.min(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1])),
                            new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(window.originCoords[0], window.destCoords[0]), Math.max(window.originCoords[1], window.destCoords[1]))
                        );
                        mapInstance.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                    }
                }, 100);
            }
        });

        // 从主进程获取旅行信息
        const ipcRenderer = require('electron').ipcRenderer;
        let AMAP_KEY = '';

        // 监听主进程发送的旅行信息
        ipcRenderer.on('travel-info', async (event, data) => {
            console.log('Received travel info:', data);
            debugInfo.textContent = `接收到旅行信息: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;

            // 更新界面信息
            if (data.origin && data.destination) {
                routeInfo.textContent = `${data.origin} → ${data.destination}`;
                currentLocation.textContent = data.origin;
                destLocation.textContent = data.destination;
            }

            // 保存旅行数据
            travelData = data;

            // 初始化高德地图
            await initMap(data);
        });

        // 初始化高德地图
        async function initMap(travelData) {
            debugInfo.textContent = '检查API Key配置...';
            console.log(travelData);

            // 从主进程获取API Key
            AMAP_KEY = window.AMAP_KEY || '';

            // 检查API Key是否存在
            if (!AMAP_KEY || AMAP_KEY === 'undefined') {
                console.error('AMap API Key not configured');
                debugInfo.textContent = '错误: API Key未配置，请在.env文件中设置AMAP_KEY';
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>API Key未配置</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">请在.env文件中设置AMAP_KEY</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            debugInfo.textContent = `API Key存在，开始地理编码: ${AMAP_KEY.substring(0, 10)}...`;

            try {
                // 获取始发地和目的地的经纬度
                let originCoords;

                // 如果有用户位置信息，优先使用
                if (travelData.userLocation && travelData.userLocation.coordinates) {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '使用用户位置作为起点...';
                    originCoords = travelData.userLocation.coordinates;
                    console.log('Using user location as origin:', originCoords);
                } else {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '获取始发地坐标...';
                    originCoords = await geocodeAddress(travelData.origin || '武汉光谷');
                    debugInfo.textContent = `始发地坐标获取成功: ${originCoords}`;
                    console.log('Origin coordinates:', originCoords);
                }

                debugInfo.textContent = '获取目的地坐标...';
                const destCoords = await geocodeAddress(travelData.destination || '北京天安门');
                debugInfo.textContent = `目的地坐标获取成功: ${destCoords}`;
                console.log('Destination coordinates:', destCoords);

                // 保存坐标到全局变量
                window.originCoords = originCoords;
                window.destCoords = destCoords;

                // 加载高德地图JS API
                debugInfo.textContent = '加载高德地图JS API...';
                await loadAMapAPI();

                // 创建地图并绘制路线
                debugInfo.textContent = '创建地图实例...';
                createMap(originCoords, destCoords, travelData);
            } catch (error) {
                debugInfo.textContent = `地图初始化错误: ${error.message}`;
                console.error('Map initialization error:', error);
                // 记录错误到日志文件
                logErrorToFile(`地图初始化错误: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>地图初始化失败</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">错误信息: ${error.message}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // 加载高德地图JS API
        function loadAMapAPI() {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = `https://webapi.amap.com/maps?v=1.4.15&key=${AMAP_KEY}`;

                script.onload = function () {
                    debugInfo.textContent = '高德地图API加载成功';
                    console.log('AMap API loaded successfully');
                    resolve();
                };

                script.onerror = function (error) {
                    debugInfo.textContent = `高德地图API加载失败: ${error.message}`;
                    console.error('AMap API loading failed:', error);
                    // 记录错误到日志文件
                    logErrorToFile(`高德地图API加载失败: ${error.message}`);
                    reject(new Error('高德地图API加载失败'));
                };

                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        // 创建地图并绘制路线
        function createMap(originCoords, destCoords, travelData) {
            try {
                // 检查AMap是否已定义
                if (typeof AMap === 'undefined') {
                    const errorMsg = 'AMap未定义，请检查API加载是否成功';
                    debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                    console.error(errorMsg);
                    // 记录错误到日志文件
                    logErrorToFile(errorMsg);
                    throw new Error(errorMsg);
                }

                // 确保坐标格式正确
                const originLngLat = Array.isArray(originCoords)
                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                    : originCoords;

                // 创建地图实例
                const map = new AMap.Map('amap-container', {
                    zoom: 12, // 更高的缩放级别，显示更详细的局部区域
                    center: originLngLat,
                    mapStyle: 'amap://styles/normal',
                    showIndoorMap: false, // 不显示室内地图
                    dragEnable: true, // 允许拖拽
                    zoomEnable: true, // 允许缩放
                    doubleClickZoom: true, // 允许双击缩放
                    scrollWheel: true // 允许滚轮缩放
                });

                // 保存地图实例到全局变量
                mapInstance = map;

                // 添加地图事件监听
                map.on('zoomend', () => {
                    const zoom = map.getZoom();
                    debugInfo.textContent = `地图缩放级别: ${zoom}`;
                });

                map.on('moveend', () => {
                    const center = map.getCenter();
                    debugInfo.textContent = `地图中心: ${center.lng.toFixed(4)}, ${center.lat.toFixed(4)}`;
                });

                // 添加点击事件，允许用户点击地图重新定位
                map.on('click', (e) => {
                    const lnglat = e.lnglat;
                    debugInfo.textContent = `点击位置: ${lnglat.lng.toFixed(4)}, ${lnglat.lat.toFixed(4)}`;

                    // 可以在这里添加反向地理编码，获取点击位置的地址信息
                    // 暂时只显示坐标信息
                });

                // 地图加载完成后调整大小
                map.on('complete', () => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        map.resize();
                    }, 100);
                });

                debugInfo.textContent = '地图实例创建成功';
                console.log('Map instance created successfully');

                // 使用高德地图WebService API获取驾车路线数据
                debugInfo.textContent = '获取驾车路线数据...';
                console.log('Starting route request with:', {
                    originCoords: originCoords,
                    destCoords: destCoords,
                    AMAP_KEY: AMAP_KEY ? 'Configured' : 'Not configured'
                });

                getDrivingRoute(originCoords, destCoords)
                    .then(routeData => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = '驾车路线数据获取成功';
                        console.log('Driving route data:', routeData);

                        // 清除加载提示
                        amapContainer.querySelector('.loading')?.remove();

                        if (routeData.status === '1' && routeData.route && routeData.route.paths && routeData.route.paths.length > 0) {
                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线规划成功，绘制路线...';
                            console.log('Route planning successful');

                            try {
                                // 解析路线数据
                                const paths = routeData.route.paths[0];
                                if (paths && paths.steps && paths.steps.length > 0) {
                                    const steps = paths.steps;

                                    // 构建路线坐标点数组
                                    let routePath = [];
                                    steps.forEach(step => {
                                        const polyline = step.polyline;
                                        if (polyline) {
                                            const points = polyline.split(';').map(point => {
                                                const [lng, lat] = point.split(',').map(Number);
                                                return new AMap.LngLat(lng, lat);
                                            });
                                            routePath = routePath.concat(points);
                                        }
                                    });

                                    // 保存路线到全局变量
                                    window.routePath = routePath;
                                    window.currentPathIndex = 0;

                                    console.log('Route path saved to window.routePath:', {
                                        length: routePath.length,
                                        firstPoint: routePath[0],
                                        lastPoint: routePath[routePath.length - 1]
                                    });

                                    // 如果有路线点，创建路线覆盖物
                                    if (routePath.length > 0) {
                                        const polyline = new AMap.Polyline({
                                            path: routePath,
                                            strokeColor: "#3366FF",
                                            strokeWeight: 6,
                                            strokeOpacity: 0.8
                                        });

                                        map.add(polyline);
                                        debugInfo.textContent = `路线绘制成功，共${routePath.length}个坐标点`;

                                        // 创建旅行者标记
                                        createTravelerMarker();
                                    } else {
                                        debugInfo.textContent = '路线点数据为空，跳过路线绘制';
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    debugInfo.textContent = '路线步骤数据为空，跳过路线绘制';
                                }
                            } catch (error) {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `路线数据处理错误: ${error.message}`;
                                console.error('Route data processing error:', error);
                            }

                            // 调整地图视野以适应路线，但优先显示起点附近
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );

                            // 如果起点和终点距离较远，优先显示起点附近
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(
                                Math.pow(originCoords[0] - destCoords[0], 2) +
                                Math.pow(originCoords[1] - destCoords[1], 2)
                            );

                            if (distance > 0.1) { // 如果距离较远（约10公里以上）
                                // 显示起点附近的详细视图
                                map.setCenter(new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]));
                                map.setZoom(14); // 更高的缩放级别显示局部详情

                                // 添加一个小的延迟，然后显示完整路线预览
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                                }, 2000);
                            } else {
                                // 距离较近时显示完整路线
                                map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);
                            }

                            // 添加起点和终点标记
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            // 添加标记点击事件
                            startMarker.on('click', () => {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `起点: ${travelData.origin}`;
                            });

                            endMarker.on('click', () => {
                                debugInfo.textContent = `终点: ${travelData.destination}`;
                                // 点击终点时，将地图中心移动到终点
                                map.setCenter(endMarker.getPosition());
                                map.setZoom(16);
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '地图绘制完成，准备开始旅行动画';
                            console.log('Map drawing completed, starting travel animation');

                            // 延迟2秒后自动开始旅行动画
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                startTravelAnimation();
                            }, 2000);
                        } else {
                            const errorMsg = `路线规划失败: ${JSON.stringify(routeData)}`;
                            debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                            console.log('Failed to get route:', routeData);
                            // 记录错误到日志文件
                            logErrorToFile(errorMsg);

                            // 即使路线规划失败，也显示起点和终点标记
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            // 调整视野以显示两个标记
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );
                            map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线规划失败，但已显示起点和终点标记';

                            // 添加一条直线连接起点和终点
                            try {
                                const directPath = [
                                    new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]),
                                    new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                ];

                                const directLine = new AMap.Polyline({
                                    path: directPath,
                                    strokeColor: "#FF6B6B",
                                    strokeWeight: 3,
                                    strokeOpacity: 0.6,
                                    strokeStyle: "dashed"
                                });

                                map.add(directLine);

                                // 创建简化的路线用于动画（在起点和终点之间插值）
                                const simplifiedPath = createSimplifiedPath(originCoords, destCoords, 50);
                                window.routePath = simplifiedPath;
                                window.currentPathIndex = 0;

                                console.log('Simplified path saved to window.routePath:', {
                                    length: simplifiedPath.length,
                                    firstPoint: simplifiedPath[0],
                                    lastPoint: simplifiedPath[simplifiedPath.length - 1]
                                });

                                // 创建旅行者标记
                                createTravelerMarker();

                                debugInfo.textContent = '已显示直线连接起点和终点，准备开始简化旅行动画';

                                // 延迟2秒后自动开始简化旅行动画
                                setTimeout(() => {
                                    startTravelAnimation();
                                }, 2000);
                            } catch (error) {
                                console.error('Failed to create direct line:', error);
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `获取路线数据失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Failed to get route data:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`获取路线数据失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);

                        // 即使路线加载失败，也显示起点和终点标记
                        try {
                            const startMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(originCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1])
                                    : originCoords,
                                title: travelData.origin || '当前位置',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#4a6cf7" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            const endMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                                position: Array.isArray(destCoords)
                                    ? new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                                    : destCoords,
                                title: travelData.destination || '北京天安门',
                                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="12" fill="#ff6b6b" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">E</text>
                                        </svg>
                                    `)
                                }),
                                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16)
                            });

                            map.add([startMarker, endMarker]);

                            // 添加一条直线连接起点和终点
                            const directPath = [
                                new AMap.LngLat(originCoords[0], originCoords[1]),
                                new AMap.LngLat(destCoords[0], destCoords[1])
                            ];

                            const directLine = new AMap.Polyline({
                                path: directPath,
                                strokeColor: "#FF6B6B",
                                strokeWeight: 3,
                                strokeOpacity: 0.6,
                                strokeStyle: "dashed"
                            });

                            map.add(directLine);

                            // 调整视野以显示两个标记
                            const bounds = new AMap.Bounds(
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.min(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.min(originCoords[1], destCoords[1])),
                                new AMap.LngLat(Math.max(originCoords[0], destCoords[0]), Math.max(originCoords[1], destCoords[1]))
                            );
                            map.setBounds(bounds, true, [20, 20, 20, 20]);

                            debugInfo.textContent = '路线加载失败，但已显示起点、终点和连接线';
                        } catch (markerError) {
                            console.error('Failed to create markers:', markerError);
                            debugInfo.textContent = '无法创建地图标记';
                        }
                    });
            } catch (error) {
                const errorMsg = `创建地图失败: ${error.message}`;
                debugInfo.textContent = errorMsg;
                console.error('Failed to create map:', error);
                // 记录错误到日志文件
                logErrorToFile(`创建地图失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                amapContainer.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="loading">
                        <div>创建地图失败</div>
                        <div class="debug-info">错误信息: ${error.message}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        // 获取驾车路线数据 - 使用WebService API
        function getDrivingRoute(originCoords, destCoords) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                // 确保坐标格式正确
                const origin = Array.isArray(originCoords) ? originCoords.join(',') : originCoords;
                const destination = Array.isArray(destCoords) ? destCoords.join(',') : destCoords;

                // 验证坐标格式
                if (!origin || !destination) {
                    const error = new Error('坐标格式错误');
                    debugInfo.textContent = `坐标格式错误: origin=${origin}, destination=${destination}`;
                    reject(error);
                    return;
                }

                const url = `https://restapi.amap.com/v3/direction/driving?origin=${origin}&destination=${destination}&key=${AMAP_KEY}`;

                debugInfo.textContent = `请求驾车路线: ${url.substring(0, 50)}...`;
                console.log('Requesting driving route:', url);
                console.log('Origin coords:', originCoords);
                console.log('Destination coords:', destCoords);

                fetch(url)
                    .then(response => {
                        if (!response.ok) {
                            throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
                        }
                        return response.json();
                    })
                    .then(data => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `驾车路线响应状态: ${data.status}, 信息: ${data.info}`;
                        console.log('Driving route response:', data);

                        // 检查API响应状态
                        if (data.status === '1') {
                            resolve(data);
                        } else {
                            const error = new Error(`API错误: ${data.info || '未知错误'}`);
                            debugInfo.textContent = `API错误: ${data.info}`;
                            reject(error);
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `请求驾车路线失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Failed to request driving route:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`请求驾车路线失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                        reject(error);
                    });
            });
        }

        // 地理编码（地址转坐标）- 使用HTTP API
        function geocodeAddress(address) {
            debugInfo.textContent = `开始地理编码: ${address}`;
            console.log('Starting geocoding:', address);

            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                // 构造请求URL
                const url = `https://restapi.amap.com/v3/geocode/geo?key=${AMAP_KEY}&address=${encodeURIComponent(address)}`;
                debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码请求URL: ${url.substring(0, 50)}...`;
                console.log('Geocoding request URL:', url);

                // 发起HTTP请求
                fetch(url)
                    .then(response => response.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码响应: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`;
                        console.log('Geocoding response:', data);

                        if (data.status === '1' && data.geocodes && data.geocodes.length > 0) {
                            // 解析坐标
                            const location = data.geocodes[0].location;
                            const [lng, lat] = location.split(',').map(Number);
                            const coords = [lng, lat];
                            debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码成功: ${coords}`;
                            console.log('Geocoding successful:', coords);
                            resolve(coords);
                        } else {
                            debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码失败，使用默认坐标`;
                            console.log('Geocoding failed, using default coordinates');
                            // 如果地理编码失败，使用默认坐标
                            if (address.includes('武汉')) {
                                resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]); // 武汉光谷
                            } else if (address.includes('北京')) {
                                resolve([116.397455, 39.909187]); // 北京天安门
                            } else {
                                // 默认使用武汉光谷坐标
                                resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]);
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(error => {
                        debugInfo.textContent = `地理编码请求失败: ${error.message}`;
                        console.error('Geocoding request failed:', error);
                        // 记录错误到日志文件
                        logErrorToFile(`地理编码请求失败: ${error.message}\n堆栈信息: ${error.stack}`);
                        // 使用默认坐标
                        if (address.includes('武汉')) {
                            resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]); // 武汉光谷
                        } else if (address.includes('北京')) {
                            resolve([116.397455, 39.909187]); // 北京天安门
                        } else {
                            // 默认使用武汉光谷坐标
                            resolve([114.402994, 30.505446]);
                        }
                    });
            });
        }

        // 记录错误到日志文件
        function logErrorToFile(errorMessage) {
            try {
                const fs = require('fs');
                const path = require('path');
                const logMessage = `[${new Date().toISOString()}] ${errorMessage}\n`;
                const logPath = path.join(__dirname, 'logs.txt');
                fs.appendFileSync(logPath, logMessage);
            } catch (logError) {
                console.error('Failed to write to log file:', logError);
            }
        }

        // 页面加载完成后请求旅行信息
        window.onload = function () {
            debugInfo.textContent = '页面加载完成，请求旅行信息...';
            // 请求主进程发送旅行信息
            ipcRenderer.send('request-travel-info');
        };

        // 全局调试函数
        window.debugTravelState = function () {
            console.log('=== Travel State Debug ===');
            console.log('window.routePath:', window.routePath);
            console.log('window.currentPathIndex:', window.currentPathIndex);
            console.log('mapInstance:', !!mapInstance);
            console.log('travelerMarker:', !!travelerMarker);
            console.log('isTraveling:', isTraveling);
            console.log('travelAnimation:', !!travelAnimation);
            console.log('travelSpeed:', travelSpeed);

            if (window.routePath) {
                console.log('Route path length:', window.routePath.length);
                console.log('First point:', window.routePath[0]);
                console.log('Last point:', window.routePath[window.routePath.length - 1]);
            }

            if (travelerMarker) {
                console.log('Traveler marker position:', travelerMarker.getPosition());
                console.log('Traveler marker visible:', travelerMarker.getVisible());
            }

            if (mapInstance) {
                const markers = mapInstance.getAllOverlays('marker');
                console.log('Total markers on map:', markers.length);
                console.log('All markers:', markers);
            }

            console.log('========================');
        };

        // 测试旅行者标记创建
        window.testTravelerMarker = function () {
            console.log('=== Testing Traveler Marker ===');

            if (!mapInstance) {
                console.log('Map instance not available');
                return;
            }

            if (!window.routePath || window.routePath.length === 0) {
                console.log('Route path not available');
                return;
            }

            // 创建测试标记
            const testMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                position: window.routePath[0],
                title: '测试标记',
                icon: new AMap.Icon({
                    size: new AMap.Size(32, 32),
                    image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                        <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 32 32" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                            <circle cx="16" cy="16" r="15" fill="red" stroke="white" stroke-width="2"/>
                            <text x="16" y="20" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">TEST</text>
                        </svg>
                    `)
                }),
                offset: new AMap.Pixel(-16, -16),
                zIndex: 200
            });

            mapInstance.add(testMarker);
            console.log('Test marker created and added to map');
            console.log('Test marker position:', testMarker.getPosition());

            // 3秒后移除测试标记
            setTimeout(() => {
                mapInstance.remove(testMarker);
                console.log('Test marker removed');
            }, 3000);
        };

        // 旅行动画相关函数
        function startTravelAnimation() {
            console.log('=== startTravelAnimation called ===');
            console.log('window.routePath:', window.routePath);
            console.log('window.currentPathIndex:', window.currentPathIndex);
            console.log('mapInstance:', !!mapInstance);
            console.log('travelerMarker:', !!travelerMarker);
            console.log('isTraveling:', isTraveling);

            if (!window.routePath || window.routePath.length === 0) {
                debugInfo.textContent = '没有可用的路线数据';
                console.error('No route path available');
                return;
            }

            if (isTraveling) {
                console.log('Animation already running, skipping...');
                return;
            }

            isTraveling = true;
            debugInfo.textContent = '开始旅行动画...';
            console.log('Starting travel animation with', window.routePath.length, 'points');

            // 创建旅行者标记（如果还没有）
            if (!travelerMarker) {
                createTravelerMarker();
            }

            // 开始动画
            console.log('Starting animation interval with speed:', travelSpeed, 'ms');
            travelAnimation = setInterval(() => {
                console.log('Animation tick - currentPathIndex:', window.currentPathIndex, 'total:', window.routePath.length);

                if (window.currentPathIndex < window.routePath.length - 1) {
                    window.currentPathIndex++;
                    const currentPos = window.routePath[window.currentPathIndex];

                    // 更新旅行者位置
                    if (travelerMarker) {
                        const oldPos = travelerMarker.getPosition();
                        travelerMarker.setPosition(currentPos);
                        const newPos = travelerMarker.getPosition();
                        console.log('Updated traveler position from:', oldPos, 'to:', newPos);

                        // 验证位置是否真的更新了
                        if (oldPos && newPos) {
                            const distance = Math.sqrt(
                                Math.pow(oldPos.lng - newPos.lng, 2) +
                                Math.pow(oldPos.lat - newPos.lat, 2)
                            );
                            console.log('Position change distance:', distance);
                        }
                    } else {
                        console.log('Traveler marker not available, creating new one...');
                        createTravelerMarker();
                    }

                    // 计算进度
                    const progress = (window.currentPathIndex / (window.routePath.length - 1)) * 100;
                    updateProgressBar(progress);

                    // 更新状态文本
                    updateStatusText(progress);

                    // 发送位置更新到主进程（用于天气更新）
                    try {
                        ipcRenderer.send('travel-position-update', {
                            lng: currentPos.lng,
                            lat: currentPos.lat,
                            progress: progress,
                            index: window.currentPathIndex,
                            total: window.routePath.length
                        });
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Error sending travel position update:', error);
                    }

                    // 跟随旅行者
                    if (mapInstance) {
                        mapInstance.setCenter(currentPos);
                    }

                    console.log(`Travel progress: ${progress.toFixed(1)}%`);
                } else {
                    // 到达目的地
                    console.log('Reached destination, stopping animation');
                    stopTravelAnimation();
                    statusText.textContent = '已抵达目的地！';
                    debugInfo.textContent = '旅行完成';
                }
            }, travelSpeed);
        }

        function stopTravelAnimation() {
            if (travelAnimation) {
                clearInterval(travelAnimation);
                travelAnimation = null;
            }
            isTraveling = false;
            debugInfo.textContent = '旅行已停止';
        }

        function createTravelerMarker() {
            console.log('=== createTravelerMarker called ===');
            console.log('mapInstance:', !!mapInstance);
            console.log('window.routePath:', window.routePath);
            console.log('routePath length:', window.routePath ? window.routePath.length : 0);

            if (!mapInstance || !window.routePath || window.routePath.length === 0) {
                console.log('Cannot create traveler marker:', {
                    mapInstance: !!mapInstance,
                    routePath: !!window.routePath,
                    routePathLength: window.routePath ? window.routePath.length : 0
                });
                return;
            }

            try {
                console.log('Creating traveler marker at position:', window.routePath[0]);

                travelerMarker = new AMap.Marker({
                    position: window.routePath[0],
                    title: '旅行者',
                    icon: new AMap.Icon({
                        size: new AMap.Size(24, 24),
                        image: 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + btoa(`
                            <svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" fill="#FFD700" stroke="#FFA500" stroke-width="2"/>
                                <text x="12" y="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="white" font-size="10" font-weight="bold">T</text>
                            </svg>
                        `)
                    }),
                    offset: new AMap.Pixel(-12, -12),
                    zIndex: 100
                });

                console.log('Traveler marker object created:', travelerMarker);

                mapInstance.add(travelerMarker);
                console.log('Traveler marker added to map successfully');
                console.log('Traveler marker position:', travelerMarker.getPosition());

                // 验证标记是否真的在地图上
                const markers = mapInstance.getAllOverlays('marker');
                console.log('Total markers on map:', markers.length);
                console.log('Traveler marker in map markers:', markers.includes(travelerMarker));

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Failed to create traveler marker:', error);
                console.error('Error details:', error.message, error.stack);
            }
        }

        function updateProgressBar(progressPercent) {
            const progressBar = document.querySelector('.progress');
            if (progressBar) {
                progressBar.style.width = progressPercent + '%';
            }
        }

        function updateStatusText(progress) {
            const remainingProgress = 100 - progress;
            const remainingHours = Math.max(0, Math.floor(remainingProgress / 100 * 11));
            statusText.textContent = `预计${remainingHours}小时后抵达，每小时寄回一张照片`;
        }

        function createSimplifiedPath(startCoords, endCoords, pointCount = 50) {
            const path = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < pointCount; i++) {
                const ratio = i / (pointCount - 1);
                const lng = startCoords[0] + (endCoords[0] - startCoords[0]) * ratio;
                const lat = startCoords[1] + (endCoords[1] - startCoords[1]) * ratio;
                path.push(new AMap.LngLat(lng, lat));
            }
            return path;
        }

        // 模拟旅星移动动画（保留原有功能作为备用）
        let progressPercent = 30;
        const moveInterval = setInterval(() => {
            // 只有在没有真实旅行动画时才使用这个
            if (!isTraveling) {
                progressPercent = Math.min(progressPercent + 1, 100);
                progress.style.width = progressPercent + '%';

                const remainingHours = Math.max(0, Math.floor((100 - progressPercent) / 100 * 11));
                statusText.textContent = `预计${remainingHours}小时后抵达，每小时寄回一张照片`;

                if (progressPercent >= 100) {
                    clearInterval(moveInterval);
                    statusText.textContent = '已抵达目的地！';
                }
            }
        }, 1000);

        // 模拟获取天气信息
        function updateWeather() {
            // 模拟不同时间的天气
            const weathers = ['☀️', '⛅', '☁️', '🌧️', '❄️', '🌟'];
            weatherEl.textContent = weathers[Math.floor(Math.random() * weathers.length)];
        }

        // 定时更新天气
        setInterval(updateWeather, 30000); // 每30秒更新一次
        updateWeather(); // 初始化天气
    </script>
</body>

</html>
```

    <script>
        // 屏蔽系统右键菜单
        document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;
        });

        // 屏蔽文本选择
        document.addEventListener('selectstart', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            return false;
        });

        const closeBtn = document.getElementById('closeBtn');
        const progress = document.getElementById('progress');
        const timeIcon = document.getElementById('time-icon');
        const dragHandle = document.getElementById('dragHandle');
        const routeInfo = document.getElementById('route-info');
        const weatherEl = document.getElementById('weather');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
        const amapContainer = document.getElementById('amap-container');
        const debugInfo = document.getElementById('debug-info');
        const currentLocation = document.getElementById('current-location');
        const destLocation = document.getElementById('dest-location');
        const zoomIn = document.getElementById('zoom-in');
        const zoomOut = document.getElementById('zoom-out');
        const resetView = document.getElementById('reset-view');
        const debugState = document.getElementById('debug-state');
        const testMarker = document.getElementById('test-marker');

        // 天气显示元素
        const weatherDisplay = document.getElementById('weather-display');
        const weatherIcon = document.getElementById('weather-icon');
        const weatherCity = document.getElementById('weather-city');
        const weatherDesc = document.getElementById('weather-desc');
        const weatherTemp = document.getElementById('weather-temp');


        // 全局变量存储地图实例和位置信息
        let mapInstance = null;
        let originCoords = null;
        let destCoords = null;
        let travelData = null;

        // 旅行动画相关变量
        let travelerMarker = null;
        let routePath = [];
        let currentPathIndex = 0;
        let travelAnimation = null;
        let isTraveling = false;
        let travelSpeed = 200; // 移动间隔（毫秒）- 调整为更慢的速度便于观察
        let totalDistance = 0;
        let traveledDistance = 0;

        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            try {
                require('electron').ipcRenderer.send('hide-map-window');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Error hiding map window:', error);
                // 如果IPC失败，则直接关闭窗口
                window.close();
